tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 1 theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos rtsa 'grel

tei:div.tei:p: the pa che po ma'i ba bcos rtsa 'a la ba sa sa lham cho lha—tswa jicirkartesnye khudzāske sto/skezhu tsā ru chosto / ṭ+wāṃske— / / //// tsho tsho spya rdzirngaji snyeshā sto r+sha— blo ca risnyeladzi gyu ci ci rik+ṣ-irijici rik+ṣ-icho 4 /sdordodzhasnyechospya ji two3 sa4chortsecibyutsāsgyuci : 4ca/cirichi rno tsā rusnasnyerunacisduci rdu //༷skesoḥ—ci — dzhatsā ṭ+wārdo dzhari //3rna / nyiṭ+wāṃ shālha'in+di warno4chorgya —khyelte/hūṃspuñtsā tshwadze+e stege 0 tso / k+ṣetone ༵ /hūṃskyishe /7 0 k+to riri༄—sred+ngha dzetrelte/ze‘༵wa/ ༷ ༄ciskre—gyi si khron dpe skrun tshogs pa/ negyusi khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

༄༅// theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos rtsa 'grel bzhugs so//rje btsun byams pa mgon pos rtsa ba mdzad/rong ston shes bya kun gzigs kyis 'grel ba brtsams/si khron dpe skrun tshogs pa/ si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

dpe skrun byas tshul gsal bshad/mkhas shing grub pa'i snyan grags kyi ba dan dkar po 'dzin ma'i tha gru kun la khyab pa'i 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi ya gyal slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med kyis dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi pho brang du rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i zhabs kyi pad+mor spyi bos btud de gsol ba btab par brten/ byams mgon mchog gis sher phyin gyi mdo sde rin po che'i don rnams byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i man ngag tu sbyar te ston pa'i gzhung sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan dang / de'i nyams len gyi gnad rnams mdo mang po las btus te rgyas par ston pa'i gzhung mdo sde rgyan dang / zhi lhag gnyis kyi nyams len dmigs su ston pa'i gzhung dbus mtha' rnam 'byed dang —/ chos dang chos nyid rnam 'byed/ mthar thug dbu ma'i lta ba dang mthun par theg pa gcig tu bsgrub pa'i gzhung rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos te byams chos sde lnga zhes yongs su grags pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi 'di bstsal to/ /dad pa gsum gyi nor gyis phyug cing blo gros kyi spyan yangs pa'i

klog pa po rnams la byams mgon gyi gzhung rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po lta bu 'dir thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa'i skal ba bzang po thob pa'i phyir dang / bod rig pa zhib 'jug gi bya bar 'bad brtson gnang bzhin pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis 'di don bde blag tu rtog dpyod bde ba'i don du/ nged dpe skrun khang gis byams chos sde lnga'i nang gses(theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos〉ces pa 'bras bu dkon mchog gsum dang / rgyu khams bde gshegs snying po/dag pa'i rkyen byang chub/ byang chub de'i yon tan/ mdzad pa phrin las te rdo rje'i gnas bdun gyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i bstan bcos chen po 'di'i rtsa ba dang / de'i 'grel pa mkhas pa'i dbang po rong ston smra ba'i seng ge shes bya kun gzigs(1367—1449)kyis brtsams pa'i (theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa bzhugs so〉zhes pa la sa bcad rnams gzhung du yig 'bru che tsam gyis mngon par byas thog de dag dkar chag tu bsgrigs te chad lhag med par par du bskrun pa lags/sgrig pa pos/2

rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i rnam thar ni/ rgyal tshab dam pa rje btsun mi pham mgon/ /zhes bsngags pa/ 'dren pa mnyam med ston pa thub pa'i dbang po dga' ldan du skye ba sprul sku'i tshul bzung ste rgyal ba 'od srungs kyi dus nas zhing 'dir 'byon pa la nye ba'i bar dga' ldan gyi lha rnams la chos bstan nas 'dzam bu'i gling du 'byon pa la nye bar phyogs pa'i tshe/ rje btsun byams pa mgon po la prog zhu bskon nas rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur bas/ de nas bzung rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po zhes grags pa rje btsun byams mgon 'di nyid sngon thugs ji ltar bskyed pa'i tshul ni/ mdo sde bskal bzang las/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa 'khor los sgyur ba yi/ /rgyal po rnam par snang byed ces byar gyur pa na/ /bde gshegs mthu chen gdugs tshod dag la spyan drangs nas/ /dang por bla med byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rje btsun byams pa mgon po 'di nyid sngon bskal pa brjod kyis mi lang ba'i yang brjod kyis mi lang ba'i sngon rol tu 'khor 3

los sgyur ba'i rgyal po rnam par snang byed ces bya bar gyur pa'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa thub pa chen po zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byon pa dang mjal te/ de bzhin— gshegs pa de la gdugs tshod phul nas mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad la byams pa dang snying rje chen pos gzigs nas sems can thams cad 'khor ba las sgrol ba'i phyir du byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed par mdzad do/ /yang bskal pa grangs med pa bas kyang ches grangs med pa yun ring zhing tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i snga rol tu/ rje btsun byams pa gling bzhi la dbang ba'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po gser mdog can zhes bya bar gyur pa'i dus rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser zangs 'od byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dpag tu med pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la/rgyal po'i 'byor pa chen po dang bsod nams kyi mthu chen pos sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams kyi 'byor pas kyang bsgrun du med pa'i bkod pa dang —/ mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur ba thams cad kyis lo bye ba phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhir bkur ster byas te bla na med pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed par mdzad/ yang sngon mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i thad du bskal pa 'dzin pa zhes bya ba byung ba la/ bskal pa chenathopo de la gling bzhi pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir gling bzhir 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud ces bya ba zhig byung ngo / /rgyal

po rtsibs kyi mu khyud de la mdun na 'don bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul zhes bya ba zhig yod do/ /de la bu skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan zhing dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus lus rnam par mdzes la bsod nams brgya'i mtshan dang ldan zhing 'od 'dom gang pa yod la shing n+ya gro dha ltar chu zheng gab cing blta bas chog mi shes pa zhig btsas so / /de btsas ma thag tu lha 'bum gyis mchod pa byas nas rgya mtsho'i snying po zhes bya bar ming btags so/ /de dus gzhan zhig na nges par byung nas skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i snying po zhes bya bar gyur nas bcos ldan 'das des chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te srog chags bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag mang po dag mtho ris dang thar pa'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod par gyur to/ /de nas bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyis 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud dang rang gi slob ma bram ze rig byed klog pa stong sogs pa la yang dang yang du bskul te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying po'i spyan sngar sems bskyed du bcug go—/ de'i tshe rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud kyis de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying po'i spyan sngar sems bskyed de/ bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa blo yul du bzung nas zhing de 'grub pa'i phyir du bskal pa 5

grangs med par rdzogs smin sbyang gsum gyi spyod pa spyad pa mthar phyin par mdzad nas bde ba can gyi zhing grub ste zhing der mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi slob ma bram ze rig byed klog pa stong po desasgrukyang de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying po'i spyan sngar sems bskyed cing / de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying pos de dag bskal pa bzang po 'di la 'tshang rgya bar lung bstan nas de dag gis rang rang gi zhing bzung ba na/ dang po 'khor ba 'jig nas tha ma mos pa snang mdzad kyilhabar thams cad kyis rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gdul sla ba dang zhing dag pa sha stag bzung nas/ rtsod ldan tshe lo brgya pa'i dus 'di dang / ma 'ongs pa'i tshe lo brgyad khri pa'i dus gnyis po 'di lus te/ de yang rtsod ldan tshe lo brgya pa'i dus 'di ni dus kyi snyigs mar gyur pas sems can rnams tshe thung zhing longs spyod dbul la nad mang zhing phal cher dus ma yin pa'i 'chi rkyen gyis 'chi bar 'gyur ba ma rungs pa dmu rgod pa/ drin lan log par 'jal bas gang ba 'di ni rgyal ba de dag thams cad skrag nas 'di lta bu'i dus ngan pa ma rungs pa 'di dag gi khrod du su zhig 'jug ces yal bar bor ba na bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyis thugs rjes ma bzod par dus 'dir 'byon pa'i thugs bskyed/ ma 'ongs pa'i tshe lo brgyad khri pa'i dus de ni snod thams cad phun sum tshogs pas gang ba/ snod

rnams lha'i yul dang mtshungs pa/ mi rnams tshe ring zhing gzugs bzang ba longs spyod che ba phan tshun 'tshe ba gang yang med cing rang bzhin gyis dge ba'i lam la gnas pa sha stag 'byung bas 'di dag ni shin tu bzang ngo zhes thams cad kyis btang snyoms su bzhag ste lus pa na—/ rje btsun byams mgon 'di nyid de'i tshe rig byed klog pa stong gi lnga pa dri med 'od ces bya bar gyur pa des thugs rjes ma bzod nas tshe lo brgyad khri ba'i dus kyi 'gro ba 'di rnams de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis btang snyoms su bzhag pas/ 'di dag la chos ston pa po med pas/ 'di dag la gnas skabs su 'khor ba'i bde 'byor cung zad yod kyang las nyon gyis bcings pas 'khor ba las ma 'das shing /slar yang 'khor ba mtha' med du 'khyams nas sdug bsngal brgyud mar myong bar 'gyur ba 'di rnams snying re rje/ 'di rnams kyi mgon du nga nyid zhing der 'tshang rgya bar bya'o snyam du thugs bskyed pa na de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying pos kyang / de ltar du bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas lnga par 'gyur bar lung bstan to/ /don gyi dbang 'di gzigs nas rje bdag nyid chen pos byams mgon la bstod pa mdzad pa na/bde gshegs snga mas btang snyoms mdzad pa yi/ /grangs med 'gro la brtse bas ma bzod nas/ /zhing 'dir byang chub snying por gshegs 'gyur ba/ /mi pham chos rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes 7

bsngags pa mdzad do/ /yang sngon 'das pa'i bskal pa brjod kyis mi lang ba'i sngon rol tu 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po yul 'khor skyong zhes bya ba byung ste/ de la bu stong yod do/ /de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan mtha' yas rin po che sna tshogs bkod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byon te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de la 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po yul 'khor skyong bu stong dang bcas pas dus yun ring por mchod cing bsnyen bkur na sa de bzhin gshegs pa de'i spyan sngar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa na de bzhin gshegs pa des rgyal bu stong po de rnams kyi ming bum par bcug nas rim bzhin lung bstan pa na/ rje btsun byams mgon 'di nyid 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po de'i bu stong gi nang nas bzhi pa ska rags can zhes bya ba yin pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa des bu stong po de rim bzhin bskal pa bzang po 'di la 'tshang rgya bar lung bstan te/ don 'di la dgongs nas/ mthun pa'i smon lam dge tshogs rmad byung zhing / /spyad pa spyod tshe na yang mched gyur la/ /bskal bzang 'di la mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod pa mdzad do/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas mang po'i spyan sngar thugs bskyed par mdzad cing bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la sogs pa bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas gzhan thams cad

las bskal pa bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyis thugs bskyed pa snga bar gsungs so—/ /de ltar rje btsun byams pa mgon pos thugs bskyed nas bskal pa bgrang ba las 'das par tshogs gnyis bar ma chad du bsags/bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa brnyes pa nas bzung bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa nyid yongs 'dzin du bsten te dbu'i gtsug tu 'bral med du bsgoms pas gdul bya rnams kyis byams mgon gyi dbu'i gtsug na byang chub mchod rten yod par mthong ste / da lta byams mgon gyi sku la dbu'i gtsug tu byang chub mchod rten re byed srol yod pa 'di yang de'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin par gsungs/de ltar rje btsun byams pa mgon pos bskal pa grangs med mu med par tshogs gnyis bar ma chad du bsags nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen gdugs zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byon pa'i tshe/ byams mgon 'di nyid dge slong blo gros brtan pa zhes bya bar gyur nas de bzhin gshegs pa de nyid la bsnyen bkur zhing lo brgyad khri bzhi stong gi bar du nyin re bzhin sems can brgya brgya tsam bslab pa'i gzhi lnga la ma bkod kyi bar du zas mi bza'/ srog chags kyi don du 'gyur ba mthong tshe zhag mang po'i bar du zas bcad kyang des mi skyo bar sems can gyi don la brtson par mdzad de srog chags bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa drug bslab pa'i gzhi lnga la bkod do/ /de ltar lo brgyad khri bzhi 9

stong gi bar du sems can gyi don mdzad nas srog chags bye ba phrag gsum theg pa chen po'i lam la bkod/ srog chags bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig theg pa dman pa'i lam la bkod/ srog chags grangs med mu med pa zhig la byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin bskyed par mdzad/tha na grong dang grong khyer dang tshong dus dang yul 'khor la sogs pa gang dang gang du byon pa'i sems can de dang de dag gis zhal mthong ba dang / gsung thos pa dang phyag gis reg pa dang gang du zhabs bzhag pa'i sa de dang de dag na gnas pa'i sems can de dag thams cad kyang byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bkod pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyis legs so'i bsngags pa brjod cing /dkar phyogs kyi lha thams cad kyis 'di lta bur sems can thams cad byams pa la 'god pa ngo mtshar ro/ /zhes rgya cher bsngags pas phyogs bcu'i zhing thams cad du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa zhes mtshan grags shing / de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen gdugs kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa 'di da nas bzung ste skye ba thams cad du byams pa'i mtshan dang ldan par 'gyur zhing / mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshe yang de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa zhes bya bar 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan to/ /de nas rje btsun byams pa mgon pos tshogs 10

gnyis phal cher rdzogs te sa bcu pa la gnas pa'i tshe 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur ba thob ste/ de'i tshul rgyas par brjod na yi ge mang du dogs pas rje bdag nyid chen pos tshigs bcad du bsgrigs nas gsungs pa ni/ ma lus sems can bde la 'god phyir du/ /rab 'byams zhing gi rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /'od zer chen po'i dbang gis mgon khyod la/ /chos kyi rgyal srid gtad pa dgongs par rigs/ /gang tshe khyod kyis dbang bskur sa brnyes tshe/ /grangs med 'bum phrag bcu yi ting 'dzin dang / /kun mkhyen ye shes nyid du dbang bskur ba'i / /ting nge 'dzin rnams mngon du gyur pa'i mthar/ /stong gsum 'bum phrag bcu yi rdul snyed kyi/ /pad+mo'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i pad+ma ni / /rtsa ba rin chen lte ba tsan dan mchog /ze'u 'bru rdo yi snying po lo ma ni/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser ltar kun tu snang / /rin chen kun gyis rab spras 'dab brgya 'byed/ /rin chen dra bas kun nas g.yogs pa la/ /de dang 'tsham par khyod sku bzhugs pa ni/ /'khor gyi pad+mar de snyed rgyal ba'i sras/ /khyod kyi zhal du phyogs nas 'khod pa rnams/ /'bum phrag bcu yi ting nge 'dzin la rol/ /de tshe khyod kyi zhabs mthil pus mo dang / /lte ba rtsibs logs phyag gi mthil gnyis nas/ /grangs med 'bum phrag bcu yi 'od phyung nas/ /ngan song gsum dang mi dang lha min lha/ /gnas kun snang byas sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzad/ /phrag pa 11

rgyab mgul zhal gyi sgo rnams nas/ /sngar gyi 'od kyis nyan rang sa dgu'i bar/ /byang sems gnas rnams snang mdzad rim bzhin du/ /chos snang ting 'dzin thabs shes tshul rnams bsgrubs/ /sngar bzhin mdzod spu nas phyung 'od zer gyis/ /phyogs bcu'i bdud gnas thams cad zil mnan nas/ /dbang bskur brnyes pa'i rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyiske/ /sku yi dkyil 'khor dag tu nub par mdzad/ /yan lag mchog las stong gsum 'bum phrag bcu'i/ /phra rab rdul snyed 'od zer phyung nas kyang / /bde gshegs 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor snang byas te/ /'jig rten lan bcur bskor nas bar snang la/ /'od kyi dra ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yis/ /kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i char phab nas—/ /'jig rten lan bcur bskor nas rgyal rnams kyi/ /zhabs kyi mthil du kun nas nub par gyur/ /de nas sras bcas rgyal bas dpa' bo khyod/ /dbang bskur dus la bab par gzigs gyur nas/ /dbang bskur thob pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ /rdo rje dpal be'u bkra shis ri mo las/ /grangs med 'bum phrag bcu yi 'od zer gyis/ /'khor bcas 'od phyung phyogs kun snang byas te/ /mu med cho 'phrul bstan nas khyod kyi ni/ /rdo rje dpal be'u bkra shis rnams su nub/ /de nas de ma thag tu khyod kyi stobs/ /'bum 'gyur las kyang lhag par 'phel ba'i tshe/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyi mdzod spu nas/ /12

sngar bzhin 'od kyis zhing kun snang byas nas/ /'jig rten lan bcu bskor te cho 'phrul bstan/ /byang sems bye ba mang bskul zhing kun bskyod / /ngan 'gro zhi mdzad bdud rnams zil mnan te/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi gdan kun rab bstan nas/ /'od zer gtso bo khyod kyi spyi bo dang / /'khor gyi 'od zer 'khor gyi spyi bor nub/ /de tshe byang sems rnams kyis sngon med pa'i/ /stong phrag bcu yi ting 'dzin thob par gyur/ /de ltar glang po rin chen gser khri yis/ /brgyan pa'i steng du 'khor los sgyur ba'i sras/ /rgya mtsho bzhi yi chus bkang gser bum gyis / /spyi bo'i gnas nas rgyas par dbang bskur ba/ /de bzhin thub pa'i chos kyi rgyal tshab tu/ /mngon par dbang bskur khyod kyis 'khor ba ru/ /las kyis kun nas mnar ba'i sems can kun/ /zag med bde ba'i dpal la 'god du gsol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /ma 'ongs pa na rje btsun byams pa mgon po zhing 'dir byon nas 'tshang rgya ba'i mdzad pa ston tshul ni/ thub pa'i bstan pa lo lnga stong du gnas pa rim gyis rdzogs nas mthar rtags tsam 'dzin pa lo lnga brgya dang / de nas de yang nub ste sems can rnams rmongs shing nyon mongs pa kho na'i dbang du song ste phan tshun gcig la gcig 'tshe zhing sdig pa kho na spyod pas bsod nams je dman je dman la song ste tshe lo nyi shu dang / de yang je thung je thung la song ste mthar tshe lo bcu la ring mtha' byed pa'i 13

dus 'byung zhing / de nas mu ge'i bskal pa dang / nad kyi bskal pa dang —/ mtshon gyi bskal pa rnams rim gyis byung ste sems can rnams phan tshun 'thab rtsod kyis sdug bsngal zhing nyam thag pa dmya la bar gnas pa lta bur 'gyur la/ de'i dus su rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i sprul pa khru gang pa sku la chos gos ngur smrig gsol ba/ gzi brjid 'bar zhing 'od 'phro ba zhig byon pa sems can de rnams kyis mthong nas ngo mtshar zhing dad pa skyes te 'di lta bu'i sku gzugs mdzes pa ci las byung zhes gsol pas/ sprul pa'i byams mgon des ngas bzod pa bsgoms pas 'di ltar byung ba yin/ khyed rnams kyang 'thab rtsod spongs la bzod pa sgoms shig /de ltar byas na nga dang 'dra bar 'gyur roske/ /zhes gsungs pas/ byams mgon gyi thugs bskyed kyi mthus sems can de dag gis bzod pa bsgoms pas rim gyis bsod nams rgyas nas tshe ring du 'phel te tshe lo nyi shu pa dang / sum cu pa sogs tshe je ring je ring du gyur cing bde skyid kyang je 'phel du song ste 'dzam bu'i gling gi sa chen po'i khyon 'di thams cad lag mthil ltar mnyam zhing yangs pa/ ngam grog dang tsher ma dang ljan ljin dang gyo mo dang gseg ma la sogs pa med cing / ne'u gsing mdzes pas khyab pa/rkang pa bteg na sor bzhi 'phar zhing mnan na nem zhes byed pa sha stag ste/ shing bal ltar 'jam pa/ 'bru dang / lo tog dang / 'khri 14

shing gel pa la sogs pas gang zhing / ha cang yang mi dro ha cang yang mi grang ba rlung shin tu chung ba/ dus dang tshad mnyam par ldang zhing dri phun sum tshogs pa/ mngar zhing zhim pa'i sa lu ma rmos par skye zhing /lha'i char babs pas sa'i bcud 'phel ba/ tshon sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i gos kyi ljon shing me tog dang 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa 'phang du rgyang grags kyi tshad tsam yod pas gang ba/ bar bar na lteng ka dang khrus kyi rdzing bu dang ldan pa ste yon tan brjod kyis mi lang ba zhig 'byung ngo / /der skyes pa'i mi rnams ni/ lus la ha ri tsan dan gyi dri bro ba/ ku sha'i gos khyad par du 'phags pa gyon pa/ lha'i dpal 'byor la longs spyod cing tshe lo brgyad khri thub pa/ lus ngag yid gsum mi dge ba dang bral ba/ kha dog bzang zhing lus gzugs che ba/de la da lta'i khru brgyad cu 'am brgyad cu rtsa brgyad pa/ 'dom nyi shu rtsa gnyis tsam yod pa/ kun kyang tshan po che'i stobs dang ldan pa/ mi de dag la 'dod pa dang za ba dang rgas pa ste de tsam ma gtogs nad gyi ming tsam yang mi grag pa lha'i lus dang khyad par med par 'gyur ro/ /ston pa'i bstan pa rtags tsam 'dzin pa 'di nub pa yan chad kyis bskal pa ya thog ring mo rdzogs pa/ de nas rje btsun byams pa mgon po ma byon gyi bar la rang sangs rgyas mang du 'byung zhing / —bar gyi khug pa bco brgyad kyi 'gor rje btsun byams pa mgon po 'byon par 15

gsungs so/ /rje btsun byams pa mgon po gang du 'byon pa'i gnas ni thub pa'i dbang po mya ngan las 'da' tshul bstan pa'i sa grong khyer rtswa can du tog gi blo gros zhes bya ba'i rgyal po'i pho brang 'byung la/ pho brang de'i char dpag tshad bcu gnyis/ zheng du dpag tshad bdun yod paske/ rin po che sna bdun gyi so phag gi rtsig pa rim pa bdun dang /'obs rim pa bdun dang / rin po che las grub pa'i ta la'i phreng ba rim pa bdun gyis bskor zhing dril bu'i dra bas mdzes pa/ de dag rlung gis bskyod pa na sil snyan yan lag lnga dang ldan pa'i sgra 'byung ste/sems can rnams dga' bar byed pa/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i me tog mad+dha ra dang / ku mud ta dang / ut+pal dang / mi yul na yod pa'i me tog sna tshogs pa'i rgyan bkram pa/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i khrus kyi rdzing bu dang / mtsho pad+mas brgyan pa rnams la chu bya mang po sgra snyan pa sna tshogs sgrog pa/ skyed mos tshal phun sum tshogs pa me tog gis gang ba yod pa/ grong khyer de'i phyogs bzhi dang dbus kun na gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i rin po che'i dpag bsam gyi shing re ba thams cad skong ba yod pas/ des lha'i 'byor pa yang zil gyis gnon par byed do/ /der gling bzhi la dbang ba'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dpung tshogs yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa/ rin po che sna bdun dang /bu stong dang ldan pa/ btsun mo brgyad khri dang / khams kyi rgyal phran 16

bzhi stong brgyad cu la dbang bsgyur ba chos kyi srid skyong ba'i rgyal po dung zhes bya ba 'byung zhing / de'i mdun na 'don chen po bram ze tshangs rab ces pa thos pa mang zhing rig byed kun la mkhas pa/ de la btsun mo tshangs ldan ma zhes bya ba sgyu rtsal gyi yon tan yongs su rdzogs shing mdzes pa zhig 'byung ste/ bram ze yab yum de gnyis kyi sras su rje btsun byams mgon 'byon par 'gyur ro/ /de yang rje btsun byams pa mgon pos dus dang yul dang rigs dang rus dang yum lnga la gzigs nas dga' ldan gyi gnas nas babs te 'dzam bu'i gling du 'byon pa yin no/ /de yang dus ni tshe lo brgyad khri pa snod bcud thams cad phun sum tshogs pa byams mgon rang nyid kyi 'dul bar 'os pa'i sems can rnams 'dul ba'i dus la gzigs pa'o/ /yul ni 'dzam bu'i gling la gzigs pa'o/ /rigs ni de'i dus mi rnams bram ze'i rigs mchog tu byed pas bram ze'i rigs la gzigs pa'o/ /rus ni yab yum gnyis ka'i rigs rgyud skyon med pa la gzigs pa'o/ /yum ni bram ze tshangs ldan ma yon tan thams cad dang ldan zhing smon lam gyi mthu can de la gzigs pa'o/ /de ltar gzigs nas dus la bab pa na lha rnams kyis mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas dga' ldan nas babs te 'dzam bu'i gling du gshegs te yum tshangs ldan ma'i lhums su zhugs so/ /de nas zla ba bcu'i ring la dkar phyogs kyi lha 17

rnams la nub re bzhin chos ston pa sogs gdul bya'i don rgya cher mdzad nas zla ba bcu song ba na yum tshangs ldan ma skyed mos tshal me tog bzang rgyas zhes bya bar byon nas phyag g.yas pas shing gi yal ga la 'jus te gnam du gzigs pa na rtsib logs g.yas nas sku bltams/de'i 'od kyis 'jig rten thams cad bkang ste skad cig de la sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal rgyun bcad de bde bas khyab par byas/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bar snang las blangs/ klu'i rgyal po rnams kyis nam mkha' las bdud rtsi'i khrus gsol/ de nas phyogs bzhir gom pa bdun bor ba'i shul du gter chen po re dang pad+ma re byung zhing /phyogs bzhir gzigs te/ nga yi skye ba'i tha ma ni/ /'di yin yang srid yod ma yin/ /yang dang yang du phyir mi 'ong / /zag med mya ngan 'das par 'gro/ /zhes gsungs/ de'i tshe byams mgon sku bltams pa dang mnyam du 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dung la sras stong dang /gzhan yang 'jig rten na ya rabs kyi rigs mang po btsa' zhing gter rnams kyang kha bye/ lha rnams kyis me tog gi char 'bebs/ byams mgon gyi dbu thog tu gdugs dkar po bzung / phyogs thams cad rol mo'i sgra sogs mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs pas khyab par byed do/ /de nas yab yum gnyis kyis gzhon nu de mtshan mkhan la bstan pa na 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' byams pa zhes bya ba yin pas myur du 18

'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung ston/ de nas byams mgon gyis sgyu rtsal ston pa sogs gzhon nu rol rtsed mdzad pas srog chags grangs med pa zhig smin grol la 'god cing lo nyi khri'i bar du khyim du bzhugs/de nas 'tshang rgya ba'i dus la bab pa na/ rgyal po dung gis rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i mchod sdong spoms su 'dom drug cu rtsa bzhi/'phang du 'dom stong yod pa zhig byams pa'i yab tshangs rabs la phul loske/ /tshangs rabs kyis bram ze rnams la byin no/ /bram ze rnams kyis de ma thag bgos so/ /rje btsun byams pas mchod sdong de nyid mi rtag par dgongs de yab la gnang ba gsol nas bram ze dang rgyal bu bzhi stong brgyad cu dang bcas te rab tu byung nas klu shing zhes pa'i byang chub kyi shing 'phang du dpag tshad tsam du 'phags shing / lo 'dab dang 'bras bus mdzes pa'i yal gas kho ra khor yug tu rgyang grags drug gi bar khebs pa'i drung du 'khod de rab tu byung ba'i nub mo nyid la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /de nas/ da ni gnas bzang mchog thob pas/ /da bzod gnas gzhan mi 'gro ste/ /'chi bdag na rga las grol bas/ /zab mo bdud rtsi'i sgo 'di rnyed/ /ces gsungs nas zhag bdun du chos ma gsungs pa las/ tshangs pas gdugs dkar po gser gyi rtsa ba can kha dog sna lnga'i mu tig dang dril bu'i dra bas g.yogs pa dpag tshad gsum yod pa 'dzin cing / lha'i rin po 19

ches brgyan pa'i gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa phul zhing /me tog dang rin po che dang spos kyi char rab tu phab ste/ rje btsun byams pa mgon po khyed nyid kyis/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla med bskor du gsol| /zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas cang mi gsung bas gnang ste/ me tog mdzes par rgyas pa'i skyed mos tshal du gshegs so/ /der gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul dag mthong bas rgyal po dang yang bu dang btsun mo dang bcas rgyal po bzhi stong brgyad cu/ tshangs rabs sogs bram ze bzhi stong brgyad cu/ srog chags stong phrag grangs med pa dag kyang 'khor der 'dus te rab tu byung ngo / /de nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i 'dus pa dang po la dgra bcom pa dung phyur phrag dgu dang bye ba phrag drug go /gnyis pa la dung phyur phrag dgu dang bye ba phrag bzhi'o/ /gsum pa la dung phyur phrag dgu dang bye ba phrag gnyis so/ /de'i tshe rgyal ba'i 'od zer gyi mthus mun pa'i cha shas ma mchis shing nyi zla'i 'od kyang zil gyis mnan pa ltar gyur nas/ nyin mtshan gyi dbye ba me tog rnams kha bye ba'i tshe nyin mo/ zum pa'i tshe mtshan mo'o/ /yang bya rnams sgra grag pa'i tshe nyin mo/ mi grag pa'i tshe mtshan mo'o/ /de tsam ma gtogs mtshan mo'i mun pa ma mchis te yul 'khor kun rtse zhing dga' mgur spyod la/ thams cad kyang byams mgon gyi mthus phan tshun byams pa la gnas shing chos bzhin spyod pa sha stag go/ /de 20

nas rgyal ba nyan thos rnams dang thabs gcig tu grong khyer du bsod snyoms la rgyu ba na/ brgya byin dang tshangs pa sogs lha thams cad kyis lha rdzas kyi me tog sna tshogs pa dang / phreng ba dang mchod pa'i bye brag rnams kyi char mngon par 'bebs la/ gang du bzhugs pa'i sa der rin po che'i khri dang 'jam zhing reg na bde ba'i gding ba gya nom pa 'ding bar byed do/ /skye dgu kun yang bstod pa'i dbyangs snyan po sogs kyis mchod do/ /de ltar lo drug khri'i bar du sems can grangs med dpag tu med brjod du med pa'i don mdzad cing 'khor lo bskor nas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ste/ sku gdung ni ril po gcig tu bzhugs so/ /rje btsun byams pa mgon po mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i tshe yab yum dang / 'khor 'dus pa dang sku tshe'i tshad la sogs pa ni mdo sde bskal bzang las/ de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa skye ba'i yul ni rgyal po'i pho brang grong khyer tog gi blo gros zhes bya'o/ /rigs ni bram ze'o/ /'od ni dpag tshad gcig go /yab ni tshangs bzang zhes bya'o/ /yum ni tshangs bdag ma zhes bya'o/ /sras ni bsod nams stobs chen zhes bya'o/ /rim gro pa ni rgya mtsho zhes bya'o/ /shes rab can rnams kyi mchog ni ye shes 'od ces bya'o/ /rdzu 'phrul can rnams kyi mchog ni brtson 'grus brtan zhes bya'o/ /'dus pa dang po la ni nyan thos dgra bcom pa dung phyur phrag dgu dang bye ba phrag drug 21

go—/ /gnyis pa la ni dung phyur phrag dgu dang bye ba phrag bzhi'o/ /gsum pa la ni dung phyur phrag dgu dang bye ba phrag gnyis so/ /sku tshe'i tshad ni lo brgyad khri bzhi stong ngo / /dam pa'i chos ni lo brgyad khri'i bar du gnas so/ /sku gdung ni ril po gcig tu 'dug go/ /mchod rten yang gcig tu zad do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /ston pa shākya'i rgyal po 'di'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas bslab pa'i gzhi rnams legs par bsrung zhing thos bsam sgom gsum la 'bad kyang theg pa gsum gyi 'bras bu ma thob pa rnams rje btsun byams pa mgon po zhing 'dir byon nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe rjes su 'dzin par thub pas gsungs shing byams mgon nyid kyis kyang zhal gyis bzhes te/ byams pa lung bstan pa'i mdo las/ shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la/ /bslab gzhi yang dag blangs nas ni/ /ji ltar gsungs bzhin rab bsgrubs na / /nga yi bstan la lhags pa yin/ /dge 'dun la yang chos gos dang / /zhal zas dang ni btung ba dang / /bsnyun gsos sna tshogs sbyin pa rnams/ /phul na nga yi bstan la lhags/ /bcu bzhi dang ni bco lnga dang —/ /de bzhin zla phyed tshes brgyad dang / /cho 'phrul gyi ni zla ba la/ /bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad bsrungs shing / /mchod dang gso sbyong legs byas na/ /nga yi bstan la lhags pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar roske/ /dga' ldan du rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i zhabs drung du skyes 22

nas byams mgon las byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i gnad rnams thos par 'dod pa rnams kyis rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i sku yid la byas te yan lag bdun pa maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa yang dang yang du 'bul ba dang —/ khas blangs pa'i bslab khrims dag par bsrung ba dang / ston pa thub pa'i dbang po dang mgon po byams pa gnyis ka la gsol ba btab na ji ltar smon pa de bzhin du 'grub par mdo las gsungs/ byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzung kha ton du byas na'ang dga' ldan du skye ba dang / byams pa mgon pos nges par rjes su 'dzin par zhal gyis bzhes shing / sngon gyi dam pa mang pos zhing gshegs khar dga' ldan du phebs bzhed nas byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs kha ton du mdzad pa dang / byams pa'i sku bzhengs pa dang / byams pa'i smon lam 'don zhing gzhan la'ang rgya cher spel bar mdzad pa'i rnam thar mang du snang— ngo / /byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i gdams ngag gi gzhung rtsa ba mthar thug pa ni sher phyin gyi mdo sde rin po che yin la/ sher phyin gyi mdo sde rin po che'i don rnams byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i man ngag tu sbyar te ston pa'i gzhung ni rje btsun byams mgon gyis mdzad pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan yin te—/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyis sher phyin gyi mdo sde rin po che'i don thams cad brjod bya dngos po brgyad/ de la nang gses kyis phye bas 23

don bdun cur gtan la phab/ de'i dang po sems bskyed nas tha ma 'phrin las kyi bar thams cad gang zag gcig gis nyams su len tshul gsal bar ston pa ni byang chub lam gyi rim pa ste/ rje bdag nyid chen pos byang chub lam gyi rim pa 'di mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi gdams ngag yin la/ zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar rje btsun byams pa mgon pos byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i gdams ngag gi gzhung rtsa ba mngon rtogs rgyan dang / de'i nyams len gyi gnad rnams mdo mang po nas btus te/ rgyas par ston pa mdo sde rgyan dang /byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i zhi lhag gnyis kyi nyams len zur du bkar nas ston pa dbus mtha' rnam 'byed dang / chos dang chos nyid rnam 'byed gnyis/ byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i lta ba'i gnad mthar thug pa mgon po klu sgrub kyis rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bkral ba'i dbu ma'i lta ba dang mthun par sems kyi chos nyid spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i rang bzhin gnas rigs gtan la phab ste mthar thug theg pa gcig tu bsgrub pa rgyud bla ma rnams mdzad de/ de dag la byams chos sde lnga zhes yongs su grags so/ /des na byang chub lam gyi rim pa la nyams len snying por bya 'dod pa rnams kyis rje btsun byams pa mgon po la gsol ba gdab pa dang / byams mgon gyi gzhung 'di dag la gces po cher bzung nas thos bsam sgom gsum la 'bad par bya'o/ /24

dkar chagatheg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos bzhugs so/ / (1)theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa bzhugs so/ / (57)'go brjod/ (58)rtsa ba'i sa bcad dang po/ bstan bcos kyi mtshan don bshad pa/ (60)rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa/ tshig don so sor dbye ba/ (62)sa bcad dang po/ lus rnam par gzhag pa/ (62)dang po/ bstan bcos kyi lus rdo rje'i gnad bdun du bsdu ba/ (62)gnyis pa/ gnas bdun mdo dang sbyar ba/ (63)gcig mdo so so nas gsungs pa'i tshul/ (63)gnyis—/ mdo gcig nas gsungs pa'i tshul/ (64)gsum / de dag gi 'brel bstan pa/ (65)(gcig)spyi'i don/ (66)(gnyis)tshig gi don/ (66)sa bcad gnyis pa/ yan lag rgyas par bshad pa/ (67)

dang po/ 'bras bu dkon mchog gsum bshad pa/ (67)gcig dkon mchog gsum so so'i ngo bo (68)(gcig)sangs rgyas dkon mchog bshad pa/ (68)(gcishimado las bstan pa'i don/ (68)(gnyibashaming bshod pa/ (69)(gsu⑪ming don sbyar ba/ (70)(gnyis)chos dkon mchog bshad pa/ (72)(gcitshimado'i don bstan pa/ (73)(gnyisakyiming bshad pa/ (73)(gsugaming don sbyar ba/ (74)(gsum)dge 'dun dkon mchog bshad pa/ (75)(gcitshimado las bstan pa'i don/ (76)(gnyibashiming bshad pa/ (77)(gsurmuming don sbyar ba/ (77)gnyis—/ gnas skabs skyabs gsum du dbye ba/ (79)(gcig)spyi'i don/ (79)(gnyis)tshig gi don/ (81)gsum/ mthar thug skyabs gcig tu bsgrub pa/ (84)bzhi—/ dkon mchog gi sgra don bshad pa/ (84)2

gnyis pa/ rgyu khams sogs bzhi bshad pa/ (85)gcig thun mong du bstan pa/ (85)(gcig)mdor bstan pa/ (86)(gnyis)rgyas par bshad pa/ (87)(gcig) bsam gyis mi khyab par bsgrub pa/ (87)(gnyigra khams sogs bzhi po rgyu rkyen du 'gyur tshul/ (89)gnyis / so sor bshad pa/ (90)(gcig)khams rgyas par bshad pa/ (91)(gcig) sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi snying po can du bstan pa/ (91)(gnyigra khams rnam gzhag bcu yis gtan la dbab pa/ (95)〈gciyisdom tshig gis mdor bstan pa/ (95)〈gnyig rgyas par bshad pa/ (95)〈 gcig〉 ngo bo dang rgyu'i don/ (96)(gcig)thun mong du bstan pa/ (96)(gnyis)so sor bshad pa/ (96)(gcig ngo bo bshad pa/ (97)(gnyigargyu bshad pa/ (97)〈gcigaspang bya/ (97)3

〈gnyigaganyen po/ (98)〈snyoganas skabs kyi 'bras bu/ (98)(ye〉 'bras bu dang las kyi don/ (99)(gcig)thun mong du bstan pa/ (99)(stso)so sor bshad pa/ (100)(r+yā 'bras bu bshad pa/ (100)〈r+yāmador bstan pa/ (101)〈rnyo rgyas par bshad pa/ (103)(rnyolas kyi don bshad pa/ (104)〈r+yārigs kyi las yodatrepa ldog pa'i sgo nas bsgrub pa/ (105)〈rnyerjes su 'gro ldog gnyis ka'i sgo nas bsgrub pa/ (106)(stse〉 ldan pa'i don/ (108)(gcig)mdor bstan pa/ (108)(stso)rgyas par bshad pa/ (109)〈d+ku 'jug pa'i don/ (110)(gcig)mdor bstan pa/ (110)(stse)rgyas par bshad pa/ (111)〈yenas skabs kyi don/ (111)(spra)mdor bstan pa/ (112)

(gnyis)rgyas par bshad pa/ (112)(r+ṣa kun tu 'gro ba'i don/ (113)(gcig)mdor bstan pa/ (113)(stso)rgyas par bshad pa/ (114)(r+ṣa〉 mi 'gyur ba'i don/ (115)(gcig)mdor bstan pa/ (115)(stse)rgyas par bshad pa/ (117)(stse)ma dag pa'i gnas skabs su mi 'gyur ba/ (117)〈rnyomador bstan pa/ (117)(stse〉 nyes pas ma gos pa bstan pa/ (118)(rgesgro〉 skye 'jig gis ma gos pa bstan pa/ (118)〈d+kurgyas par bshad pa/ (119)(stse〉 nyes pas ma gos pa/ (119)〈stse〉 skye 'jig gis ma gos pa/ (119)1r+pādon/ ji — (119)2 dpe don sbyar ba/ (120)3 chos mthun bshad pa/ (120)(gsum〉 bsdu ba/ dze (121)1rnyo pas ma gos pa bstan ba/ (122)5

spro+o/ /theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos bzhugs so/ /rje btsun byams pa mgon pos rtsa ba mdzad pa/

༄/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā ya na ut+tar tan+t+ra shāsta/ bod skad du/theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas chos tshogs khams dang byang chub dang / /yon tan sangs rgyas 'phrin las tha ma ste/ /bstan bcos kun gyi lus ni mdor bsdu na/ /rdo rje yi ni gnas bdun 'di dag go /'di dag rang mtshan nyid kyi rjes 'brel ba/ /go rim ji bzhin gzungs kyi rgyal po'i mdor/ /gnas gzhi las ni gnas gsum rig bya ste/ /gzhi ni blo ldan rgyal chos dbye ba las/ /sangs rgyas las chos chos las 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /tshogs las snying po ye shes khams thob mthar/ /ye shes de thob byang chub mchog thob sogs/ /sems can kun don byed chos rnams dang ldan/ /gang zhig thog ma dbus mtha' med zhi sangs rgyas nyid rang rnam sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas nas ni ma rtogs rtogs phyir 'jig med rtag pa'i lam ston pa/ /mkhyen brtse'i ral gri rdo rje mchog bsnams sdug bsngal myu gu gcod mdzad cing —/ /sna tshogs lta thibs kyis bskor the tshom rtsig pa 'jig mdzad de la 'dud/ /'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub/ /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa/ /mkhyen dang brtse dang nus par ldan/ /don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /thog ma dbus mtha' med pa yi/ /rang bzhin yin phyir 'dus ma byas/ /zhi ba chos kyi sku can phyir/ /lhun

gyis grub ces bya bar brjod/ /so so rang gis rtogs bya'i phyir/ /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa/ /de ltar rnam gsum rtogs phyir mkhyen—/ /lam ston phyir na thugs brtse ba/ /nus pa ye shes thugs rje yis—/ /sdug bsngal nyon mongs spong phyir ro/ /dang po gsum gyis rang don te/ /phyi ma gsum gyis gzhan don yin/ /gang zhig med min yod min yod med ma yin yod med las gzhan du'ang / /brtag par mi nus nges tshig dang bral so so rang gis rig zhi ba/ /dri med ye shes 'od zer snang ldan dmigs pa kun la chags pa dang / / sdang dang rab rib rnam par 'joms mdzad dam chos nyi ma de la 'dud/ /bsam med gnyis med rtog med pa/ /dag gsal gnyen po'i phyogs nyid kyis/ /gang zhig gang gis chags bral ba/ /bden gnyis mtshan nyid can de chos—/ /chags bral nyid ni 'gog pa dang / /lam gyi bden pa dag gis bsdusaglu/ /go rim ji bzhin de dag kyang / /yon tan gsum gsum gyis rig bya/ /brtag min phyir dang brjod min phyir/ /'phags pas mkhyen phyir bsam med nyid/ /zhi nyid gnyis med rtog med de/ /dag sogs gsum ni nyi bzhin 3ste /sems de rang bzhin 'od gsal bas na nyon mongs ngo bo med gzigs pas/ /gang dag 'gro kun bdag med mtha' zhi yang dag rtogs nas thams cad la/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rjes zhugs gzigs pa sgrib pa med pa 'i blo mnga' ba/ /sems 4

can rnam dag mtha' yas yul can ye shes gzigs mnga' de la 'dud / /ji lta ji snyed nang gi ni/ /ye shes gzigs pa dag pa'i phyir//blo ldan phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs/ /bla med yon tan dang ldan nyid/ /'gro ba zhi ba'i chos nyid du/ /rtog phyir ji lta nyid de yang / /rang bzhin gyis ni yongs dag phyir/ /nyon mongs gdod nas zad phyir ro/ /shes bya mtha ra thug rtogs pa'i blos/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos nyid ni—/ /sems can thams cad la yod par/ /mthong phyir ji snyed yod pa nyid / /de ltar rtogs pa gang yin de/ /so so rang shes mthong ba nyid//dri med dbyings la chags med dang / /thogs med phyir de dag pa yin/ /ye shes gzigs pa dag pas na/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bla med phyir/ /'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa ni/ /lus can kun gyi skyabs yin no/ /ston pa bstan pa bslab don gyis/ /theg pa gsum dang byed gsum la//mos pa rnams kyi dbang byas nas/ /skyabs gsum rnam par bzhag pa yin—/ /spang phyir bslu ba'i chos can phyir/ /med phyir 'jigs dang bcas pa'i phyir/ /chos rnams gnyis dang 'apags pa'i tshogs/ /gtan gyi skyabs mchog ma yin no/ /dam pa'i don du 'gro ba yi/ /skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin/ /thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir/ /tshogs kyang de yi mthar thug phyir/ /'byung bstadakon phyir dri med phyir/ /mthu ldan phyir dang 'jig rten gyi/ ci /rgyan gyur phyir dang mchog nyid 5

phyir—/ /'gyur ba med phyir dkon mchog nyid/ /dri bcas de bzhin nyid dang dri ma med/ /dri med sangs rgyas yon tan rgyal ba'i mdzad/ /gang las dkon mchog dge ba gsum 'byung ba/ /don dam gzigs pa rnams kyi yul nyid do/ /dkon mchog gsum po 'di yi rigs/ /thams cad gzigs pa rnams kyi yul/ /de yang rnam bzhi go rims bzhinaske/ /rgyu bzhi yis ni bsam mi khyab/ /dag dang nyon mongs dang ldan phyir/ /kun nas nyon mongs med dag phyir/ /rnam par dbye ba med chos phyir/ /lhun grub rnam par mi rtog phyir/ /rtogs bya rtogs pa de yi ni/ /yan lag rtogs par byed phyir te/ /go rim ji bzhin gnas gcig de/ /dag rgyu gsum ni rkyen yin no/ /rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang / /de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang / /rigs yod phyir na lus can kun/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can/ /sangs rgyas ye shes sems can tshogs zhugs phyir/ /rang bzhin dri med de ni gnyis med deki/ /sangs rgyas rigs la de 'bras nyer brtags phyir/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas snying po can du gsungs/ /ngo bo rgyu 'bras las ldan 'jug pa dang / /gnas skabs de bzhin kunaskru 'gro ba'i don/ /rtag tu mi 'gyur yon tan dbyer med ni/ /don dam dbyings kyi dgongs don yin zhes bya/ /rin namad+kukha' chu dag ba zhin/ co /rtag tu rang bzhin nyon mongs med/ /chos mos lhagapa'i shes rab dang / /ting

'dzin snying brtse las byung ba/ /mthu dang gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /brlan pa'i ngo bo'i rang bzhin phyir/ /'di dag nor bu rin chen mkha' / /chu yi yon tan chos mthun nyid/ /chos la khong khro bdag lta dang —/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs dang / /sems can don la ltos med nyid/ /'dod chen mu stegs nyan thos dang / /rang byung rnams kyi sgrib rnam bzhi/ /dag rgyu lhag par mos pa la/ /sogasawā'i chos ni rnam bzhi nyid/ /theg mchog la mos sa bon shes rab ni/ /sangs rgyas chos bskyed ma dang bsam gtan gyi/ /bde ba'i mngal gnas snying rje'i ma ma can/ /gang yin de dag thub pa'i rjes skyes sras/ /gtsang bdag bde dang rtag nyid kyi/ /yon tan pha rol phyin pa 'bras/ /sdug bsngal yid 'byung zhi thob par/ /'dun dang smon pa'i las can no / /'di dag 'bras ni mdor bsdu na/ /chos kyi sku la phyin ci log /rnam pa bzhi las bzlog pa yi/ /gnyen pos rab tu phye ba nyid/ /de ni rang bzhin dag phyir dang / /bag chags spang phyir gtsang ba yin/ /bdag dang bdag med spros pa dag /nye bar zhi bas dam pa'i bdag /yid kyi rang bzhin phung po dang / /de rgyu log phyir bde ba nyid/ /'khor ba dang ni myangan 'das/ /mnyam pa nyid du rtogs phyir rtag /bdag sred ma lus shes rab kyis bcad de/ /sems can sred phyir brtse ldan zhi thob min/ /de ltar blo brtse byang chub thabs brten nas/ /7

'phags pa 'khor ba'amalha ngan 'da' mi 'gyur/ /gal te sangs rgyas khams med na/ /sdug la skyo bar mi 'gyur zhing / /mya ngan 'das la 'dod pa dang / /don gnyer smon pa'ang med par 'gyur/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das la de'i/ /sdug bde'i skyon yon mthong ba 'di/ /rigs yod las yin gang phyir de/ /rigs med dag la med phyir ro/ /rgya mtsho che bzhin dpag med pa'i/ /yon tan rin chen mi zad gnas/ /dbyer med yon tan dang ldan pa'i/ /ngo bo nyid phyir mar me bzhin/ /chos sku rgyal ba'i ye shes dang / /thugs rje'i khams ni bsdus pa'i phyir/ /snod dang rin chen chu yis ni/ /rgya mtsho dang ni mtshungs par bstan/ /dri med gnas la mngon shes dang / /ye shes dri med de nyid dang / /rnam dbyer med phyir mar me yi/ /snang dang dro mdog chos mtshungs canaske/ /so so'i skye 'phags rdzogs sangs kyi/ /de bzhin yid dbye'i 'jug pa las/ /de nyid gzigs pas sems can la/ /rgyal ba'i snying po 'di bstan to/ /so so skye bo phyin ci log /bden pa mthong ba bzlog pa ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ji lta bzhin/ /phyin ci ma log spros med nyid/ /ma dag ma dag dag pa dang / /shin tu rnam dag go rims bzhin/ /sems can byang chub sems dpa' dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa zhes brjod do/ /ngo bo nyid la sogs pa'i don/ /'di drug gis ni bsdus pa yi/ /khams ni gnasaskabs gsum dag tu/ /ming

gsum gyis ni bstan pa yin/ /ji ltar rtog med bdag nyid can/ /nam mkha' kun tu rjes song ltar/ /sems kyi rang bzhin dri med dbyings—/ /de bzhin kun tu 'gro ba nyid/ /de spyi'i mtshan nyid nyes pa dang —/ /yon tan mthar thug khyab pa ste/ /gzugs kyi rnam pa dman pa dang ske/ /bar ma mchog la nam mkha' bzhin/ /nyes pa glo bur dang ldan dang —/ /yon tan rang bzhin nyid ldan phyir/ /ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do/ /ji ltar nam mkha' kun song ba/ /phra phyir nye bar gos pa med/ /de bzhin sems can thams cad la/ /gnas 'di nye bar gos pa med/ /ji ltar 'jig rten thams cad du/ /nam mkha' la ni skye zhing 'jig /de bzhin 'dus ma byas dbyings la/ /dbang po rnams ni skye zhing 'jig /ji ltar nam mkha' me rnams kyis/ /sngon chad nam yang tshig pa med/ /de bzhin 'di ni 'chi ba dang / /na dang rga ba'i mes mi 'tshig /sa ni chu la chu rlung la/ /rlung ni mkha' la rab tu gnas/ /mkha' ni rlung dang chu dag dang / /sa yi khams la gnas ma yin/ /de bzhin phung po khams dbang rnams//las dang nyon mongs dag la gnas/ /las dang nyon mongs tshul bzhin min / /yid la byed la rtag tu gnas/ /tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed ni—/ /sems kyi dag pa la rab gnas/ /sems kyi rang bzhin chos rnams ni/ /thams cad la yang gnas pa med/ /sa dang 'dra ba phung po

dang —/ /skye mched khams rnams shes par bya/ /chu khams dang 'dra lus can gyi/ /las dang nyon mongs shes bya ste/ /tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed ni/ /rlung gi khams dang 'dra bar lta/ /rang bzhin nam mkha'i khams bzhin du/ /de bzhin can min gnas pa med/ /tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed ni/ /sems kyi rang bzhin la gnas te/ /tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed kyis/ /las dang nyon mongs rab tu phye/ /las dang nyon mongs chu las ni/ /phung po skye mched khams rnams 'byung / /de 'jig pa dang chags pa ltar/ /skye dang 'jig par 'gyur ba yin/ /sems kyi rang bzhin nam mkha' yi/ /khams ltar rgyu med rkyen med de/ /tshogs pa med cing skye ba dang / /'jig dang gnas la'ang yod ma yin/ /sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal gang yin pa/ /de ni nam mkha' bzhin du 'gyur med de/ /yang dag min rtogs las byung 'dod chags sogasaspyo/ /glo bur dri mas de nyon mongs mi 'gyur/ /las dang nyon mongs chu sogs kyis/ /'di ni mngon par 'grub min te/ /'chi dang na dang rga ba'i me/ /mi bzad pas kyang 'tshig mi 'gyur/ /dus mtha' dmyal ba tha mal pa'i/ /me gsum 'chi dang na ba dang / /rga ba'i me gsum rim bzhin du/ /de dag 'dra bar shes par bya/ /skye 'chi na dang rga ba las grol ba/ /'di yi rang bzhin ji bzhin nyid rtogs te/ /skye sogs phongs dang bral yang de yi rgyus/ /blo ldan 'gro 10

la snying rje bskyed phyir bsten/ /'phags pas 'chi dang na ba dang / /rga ba'i sdug bsngal rtsad nas spangs/ /las dang nyon mongs dbang gis skye—/ /de la de med phyis de med/ /ji bzhin yang dag mthong ba'i phyir//skye sogs rnams las 'das gyur kyang / /snying rje'i bdag nyid skye ba dang / /'chi dang rga dang na bar ston/ /rgyal sras 'gyur med chos nyid 'di / /rtogs nas ma rig ldongs rnams kyis/ /skye ba la sogs dag tu ni / /mthong ba gang yin de smad do/ /'phags pa'i spyod yul thob pa gang ske/ /byis pa'i spyod yul du ston te/ /de nyid phyir na 'gro ba yi/ /gnyen gyi thabs dang snying rje mchog /de ni 'jig rten thams cad las//'das kyang 'jig rten las ma g.yos/ /'jig rten don du 'jig rten na / /'jig rten dri mas ma gos spyod/ /ji ltar pad+ma chu nang du/ /skyes pa chu yis gos pa med/ /de bzhin 'di ni 'jig rten du/ /skyes kyang 'jig rten chos mi gos/ /bya ba sgrub la rtag tu blo/ /me bzhin du ni 'bar ba dang / /zhi ba'i bsam gtan snyoms 'jug la/ /rtag tu snyoms par zhugs pa yin/ /sngon gyi 'phen pa'i dbang dang ni/ /rnam rtog thams cad bral ba'i phyir/ /de ni lus can smin pa yi/ /don du 'bad pa byed ma yin/ /bstan dang gzugs sku dag dang ni/ /spyod dang spyod lam gyis kyang rung / /gang zhig ji ltar gang gis 'dul/ /des de de lta nyid du shes/ /de ltar nam mkha'i mtha' klas kyi/ /'gro 11

la rtag tu lhun grub par/ /thogs med blo ldan de yis ni/ /sems can don ni yang dag 'jug /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul 'di ni/ /rjes thob de bzhin gshegs rnams dang / /sems can yang dag sgrol ba la—/ /'jig rten na ni mnyam pa nyid/ /de lta mod kyi sa rdul dang / /rgya mtsho ba glang rmig rjes kyi/ /khyad par gang yin sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i khyad de nyid/ /gzhan 'gyur min bdag mi zad chos ldan phyir/ /'gro skyabs phyi ma'i mtha' med mur thug phyir/ /de ni rtag tu gnyis med mi rtog phyir/ /'jig med chos kyang ma byas rang bzhin phyir/ /skye ba med cing 'chi ba med/ /gnod med rga ba med pa ste—/ /de ni rtag dang brtan phyir dang / /zhi ba'i phyir dang g.yung drung phyir—/ /de ni yul gyi rang bzhin phyir/ /lus kyi skye med rtag pa'i phyir//bsam mi khyab 'gyur 'chi 'pho yis/ /de ni mi 'chi brtan pa'i phyir/ /bag chags phra mo'i nad rnams kyis/ /gnod med zhi ba nyid kyi phyir/ /zag med mngon par 'du byed kyis/ /g.yung drung phyir na rga ba med/ /de la tshig gnyis de bzhin gnyis/ /gnyis dang gnyis kyis go rims bzhin—/ /'dus ma byas pa'i dbyings la ni/ /rtag pa la sogs don shes bya/ /mi zad yon tan dang ldan phyir/ /gzhan 'gyur min bdag rtag pa'i don/ /mtha' yi mu dang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ /skyabs kyi bdag nyid brtan pa'i don/ /rnam par mi rtog rang bzhin phyir/ /12

gnyis med chos nyid zhi ba'i don/ /ma bcos yon tan nyid phyir na/ /'jig med don ni g.yung drung nyid/ /gang phyir de ni chos sku de ni de bzhin gshegs/ /de ni 'phags pa'i bden pa don dam mya ngan 'das—/ /de phyir nyi dang zer bzhin yon tan dbyer med pas/ /sangs rgyas nyid las ma gtogs mya ngan 'das pa med/ /mdor na zag med dbyings la ni/ /don gyi rab tu dbye ba bzhis/ /chos kyi sku la sogs pa yi/ /rnam grangs bzhir ni rig par bya/ /sangs rgyas chos dbyer med pa dang / /de rigs de bzhin thob pa dang / /brdzun med bslu med chos nyid dang / /gdod nas rang bzhin zhi nyid do/ /rnam kun mngon rdzogs byang chub dang / /dri ma bag chags bcas spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas mya ngan 'das pa ni/ /dam pa'i don du gnyis med nyid/ /rnam pa thams cad grangs med pa/ /bsam med dri med yon tan dang —/ /dbyer med mtshan nyid thar pa ste/ /thar pa gang de de bzhin gshegs / /ji ltar ri mo 'dri byed pa/ /gzhan dang gzhan la mkhas pa dag /gang zhig yan lag gang shes pa/ /de gzhan nges zin med par 'gyur—/ /de nas 'di la khyed kun gyis/ /nga yi gzugs ni gyis shig ces—/ /mnga' bdag rgyal pos de dag la/ /bka' yis ras ni byin pa dang —/ /de las de ni thos gyur te/ /ri mo'i las la rab sbyor ro/ /de la mngon par sbyor rnams la/ /gcig gcig yul gzhan song gyur pa/ /13

de ni yul gzhan song bas na/ /de ma tshang phyir ri mo de/ /yan lag thams cad yongs rdzogs par/ /mi 'gyur bzhin shes dper byas so/ /de rnams 'dri byed gang yin pa/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod la sogs—/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /stong pa nyid ni gzugs su brjod—/ /shes rab ye shes rnam grol rnams/ /gsal dang 'phro dang dag phyir dang / /tha dad med phyir 'od dang zer/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams dang mtshungs/ /des na sangs rgyas ma thob bar mya ngan 'das pa mi thob ste/ /'od dang 'od zer spangs nas ni/ nyi ma lta bar mi nus bzhin/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i snying po ni/ /rnam gzhag rnam pa bcu zhes brjod/ /nyon mongs sbubs nang gnas pa de/ /dpe dag gis ni shes par bya/ /sangs rgyas pad ngan sprang rtsi sbrang ma la/ /sbun la snying po mi gtsang nang na gser/ /sa la gter dang smyug sogs 'bras chung dang / /gos hrul nang na rgyal ba'i sku dang ni/ /bud med ngan ma'i lto na mi bdag dang / /sa la rin chen gzugs yod ji ltar b.raske/ /glo bur nyon mongs dri mas bsgribs pa yi/ /sems can rnams la de bzhin khams 'di gnas/ /dri ma pad+ma srog chags sbun pa mi gtsang sa 'bras go hrul dang / /sdug bsngal 'bar bas mngon par gdungs ba'i bud med sa yi khams dang mtshungs/ /sangs rgyas sbrang rtsi snying po gser dang gter dang n+ya gro rin chen sku/ /gling bdag mchog 14

dang rin chen gzugs dang dri med khams mchog mtshungs pa nyid/ /ji ltar mdog ngan pad ma'i khong gnas pa/ /mtshan stong gis 'bar de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /dri med lha yi mig ldan mis mthong nas/ /chu skyes 'dab ma'i sbubs nas 'byin byed pa/ /de bzhin bde gshegs mnar med gnas rnams la'ang / /sangs rgyas spyan gyis rang chos nyid gzigs te/ /sgrib med phyi mtha'i mur gnas thugs rje yi/ /bdag cag sgrib pa las ni grol bar mdzad/ /ji ltar mi sdug pad+ma zum la bde bar gshegs pa ni/ /de yi khong gnas lha mig mthong nas 'dab ma gcod byed ltar/ /chags sdang sogs dri sbubs bsgribs rdzogs sangs snying po 'gro gzigs te/ /thugs rjes thub pa de bzhin sgrib pa de ni 'joms par mdzad/ /ji ltar srog chags tshogs bskor sbrang rtsi ni/ /skyes bu mkhas pas de don gnyer ba yis/ /mthong nas thabs kyis de dang srog chags tshogs/ /kun nas bral bar rab tu byed pa bzhin/ /drang srong chen pos kun mkhyen spyan gyis ni/ /rig khams sbrang rtsi dang 'dra de gzigs nas/ /de yi sgrib pa sbrang ma dang 'dra ba/ /gtan nas rab tu spong bar mdzad pa yin/ /ji ltar sbrang rtsi srog chags bye ba khrag khrig stong bsgribs sbrang rtsi don gnyer mis/ /sbrang ma de dag bsal te ci ltar 'dod pa bzhin du sbrang rtsi'i bya byed pa/ /de bzhin lus can la yod zag pa med pa'i shes pa sbrang ma'i rtsi dang 'dra/ /nyon 15

mongs sbrang ma dang 'dra de 'joms pa la mkhas pa'i rgyal ba skyes bu bzhin—/ /ji ltar sbun ldan 'bru yi snying po ni/ /mi rnams kyis ni spyad byar mi 'gyur ba/ /zas sogs don du gnyer ba gang yin pa/ /de dag gis ni sbun nas de 'byin ltar/ /de bzhin sems can la yod nyon mongs kyi/ /dri ma dang 'dres rgyal ba'ang ji srid du/ /nyon mongs dri ma 'dres las ma grol ba/ /de srid rgyal mdzad srid gsum 'du mi byed—/ /ji ltar sā lu bra bo nas 'bru'i snying po sbun las ma byung gra ma canaske/ /legs par ma bsgrubs mi rnams kyis ni spyad bya bza' ba zhim por mi 'gyur ltar/ /de bzhin sems can la yod chos kyi dbang phyug nyon mongs sbubs las ma grol lus/ /nyon mongs bkres pas nyen pa'i 'gro la chos kyi dga' ba'i ro ster 'gyur ba min/ /ji ltar rab tu rgyu tshe mi yi gser/ /ljan ljin rul ba'i gnas su lhung gyur pa/ /mi 'jig chos can de ni der de bzhin/ /lo brgya mang po dag tu gnas pa de/ /lha mig rnam dag dang ldan lha yis der/ /mthong nas mi la 'di na yod pa'i gser/ /rin chen mchog 'di sbyangs te rin chen gyis/ /bsgrub par bya ba gyis zhes smra ba ltar/ /de bzhin thub pas mi gtsang dang 'dra ba'i—/ /nyon mongs su bying sems can yon tan ni/ /gzigs nas nyon mongs 'dam de dag bya'i phyir/ /skye dgu rnams la dam chos chu char 'bebs/ /ji ltar ljan ljin rul pa'i gnas su lhung ba'i gser 16

ni lha yis mthong gyur nas/ /kun tu dag par bya phyir mchog tu mdzes pa mi la nan gyis ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin rgyal bas nyon mongs mi gtsang chen por lhung gyur rdzogs sangs rin po che/ /sems can rnams la gzigs nas de dag bya phyir lus can rnams la chos ston to/ /ji ltar mi dbul khyim nang sa 'og na/ /mi zad pa yi gter ni yod gyur la—/ /mi des de ma shes te gter de yang / /de la nga 'dir yod ces mi smra ltar/ /de bzhin yid kyi nang chud rin chen gter/ /dri med gzhag dang bsal med chos nyid kyang / /ma rtogs pas na dbul ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ /rnam mang rgyun du skye dgu 'dis myong ngo / /ji ltar dbul po'i khyim nang du ni rin chen gter chud gyur pa'i mi la ni/ /rin chen gter bdag yod ces rjod par mi byed de ni mi yis shes min ltar/ /de bzhin chos gter yid kyi khyim gnas sems can rnams ni dbul po lta bu ste/ /de dag rnams kyis de thob bya phyir 'jig rten du ni drang srong yang dag bltams/ /ji ltar a mra la sogs shing 'bras la/ /yod pa'i sa bon myu gu 'jig med chos/ /sa rmos chu sogs ldan pa'i ljon shing gi rgyal po'i dngos po rim gyis 'grub pa ltar/ /sems can rnams kyi ma rig sogs 'bras kyi/ /pags sbubs nang chud chos khams dge ba yang / /de bzhin dge ba de de la brten nas/ /rim gyis thub pa'i rgyal po'i dngos por 'gyur/ /chu dang nyi ma'i 'od dang rlung dang 17

sa dus nam mkha'i rkyen rnams kyis/ /ta la dang ni a mra'i 'bras sbubs gseb nas shing skye ji ltar bar/ /sems can nyon mongs 'bras lpags nang chud rdzogs sangs sa bon myu gu yung / /de bzhin dge rkyen de dang de las chos mthong 'phel bar 'gyur ba yin/ /ji ltar rin chen las byas rgyal ba'i gzugs/ /gos hrul dri ngan gyis ni gtums gyur pa/ /lam gnas lha yis mthong nas grol bya'i phyir/ /lam gnas don de de la smra ba ltar/ /thogs med spyan mnga' rnam pa sna tshogs kyi/ /nyon mongs kyis gtums bde gshegs dngos po nyid/ /dud 'gro la yang gzigs nas de bzhin de/ /thar par bya 'di don du thabs ston mdzod—/ /ji ltar rin chen rang bzhin de bzhin gshegs sku dri ngan gos gtums pa/ /lam gnas lha yi mig gis mthong nas thar phyir mi la ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin nyon mongs gos hrul gyis gtums 'khor ba'i lam na gnas pa'i khams/ /dud 'gro la yang gzigs nas thar par bya phyir rgyal ba chos ston to/ /ji ltar mi mo gzugs ngan mgon med 'ga'/ /mgon med 'dug gnas su ni 'dug gyur la/ /mngal gyis rgyal po'i dpal ni 'dzin byed pas/ /rang lto na yod mi bdag mi shes ltar/ /srid par skye ba mgon med khyim bzhin te/ /ma dag sems can mngal ldan bud med bzhin/ /de la gang zhig yod pas mgon bcas pa/ /dri med khams ni de yi mngal gnas bzhin/ /ji ltar bud 18

med lus la dri bcas gos gyon mi sdug gzugs ldan pa/ /sa bdag mngal na gnas kyang mgon med khang par sdug bsngal mchog myong ltar//de bzhin bdag rang nang gnas mgon yod gyur kyang mgon med blo ldan pa/ /'gro ba nyon mongs dbang gis yid ma zhi bas sdug bsngal gzhi la gnas/ /ji ltar nang gi gser zhun gzugs rgyas pa/ /zhi ba phyi rol sa yi rang bzhin can/ /mthong nas de shes pa dag nang gi gser—/ /sbyang phyir phyi rol sgrib pa sel byed ltar/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal dri med rnams kyang ni/ /glo bur bar ni rnam par gzigs gyur nasaske/ /rin chen 'byung gnas lta bu'i 'gro ba rnams/ /sgrib pa dag la sbyong mdzad byang chub mchog /ji ltar dri med gser 'bar las byas sa yi nang du chud gyur gzugs/ /zhi de rang bzhin mkhas pas rig nas sa dag sel bar byed par ltar/ /de bzhin kun mkhyen dag pa'i gser 'dra zhi ba'i yid ni mkhyen gyur nas/ /chos 'chad tshul gyis brdeg spyad sgrub pas sgrib pa dag ni sel bar mdzad/ /pad+ma srog chags bung ba dang / /sbun pa dang ni mi gtsang sa/ /'bras shun gos hrul bud med kyi/ /mngal dang sa yi sbubs na yang / /sangs rgyas sbrang rtsi snying po bzhin/ /gser bzhin gter bzhin ljon pa bzhin/ /rin chen sku dang 'khor lo yis/ /bsgyur ba bzhin dang gser gzugs bzhin—/ /sems can khams kyi nyon mongs sbubs/ /ma 'brel thog ma 19

med pa na/ /sems kyi rang bzhin dri med ni/ /thog ma med pa yin par brjod/ /chags dang sdang dang rmongs dang de'i/ /kun ldang drag dang bag chags dang / /mthong sgom lam spang ma dag dang / /dag pa'i sa la brten pa yi/ /dri ma rnam dgu pad+ma yi/ /sbubs sogs dpe ni rab bstan te/ /nye ba'i nyon mongs sbubs kyi ni/ /dbye ba bye ba mtha' las 'das chags sogs dri ma dgu po 'di/ mdor bsdus nas ni go rim bzhin/ /pad+ma'i sbubs la sogs pa yi/ /dpe dgu dag gis yang dag bstan/ /dri 'di dag gis byis rnams dang / /dgra bcom slob pa blo ldan rnams/ /rim bzhin bzhi dang gcig dang ni/ /gnyis dang gnyis kyis ma dag nyid/ /ji ltar pad+ma 'dam skyes de/ /mdun du gyur na yid dga' dang / /phyis nas dga' ba med 'gyur ba/ /'dod chags dga' ba de bzhin no/ /ji ltar srog chags sbrang ma ni/ /shin tu 'khrugs te mdung brdeg ltar/ /de bzhin zhe sdang skye bas na/ /snying la sdug bsngal skyed par byed/ /ji ltar 'bras sogs snying po ni/ /phyi rol sbun pas bsgribs pa ltar/ /de bzhin snying po'i don mthong ba /ma rig sgo nga'i sbubs kyis bsgribs/ /ji ltar mi gtsang mi mthun pa/ /de bzhin chags dang bcas rnams kyi/ /'dod pa bsten pa'i rgyu yin phyir—/ /kun nas ldang ba mi gtsang 'dra/ /ji ltar nor ni bsgribs pas na—/ /mi shes gter mi thob pa ltar/ /de bzhin skye la rang byung nyid/ /20

ma rig bag chags sa yis bsgribs/ /ji ltar myug sogs rim skye bas//ba son shun pa gcod pa ltar/ /de bzhin de nyid mthong ba yis/ /mthong spang rnams ni bzlog par 'gyur/ /'phags pa'i lam dang 'brel ba las/ /'jig tshogs snying po bcom rnams kyis/ /bsgom lam ye shes spang bya rnams/ /gos hrul dag dang mtshungs par bstan/ /sa bdun la brten dri ma ni/ /mngal sbubs dri ma dag dang mtshungs/ /mngal sbubs bral 'dra mi rtog pa'i/ /ye shes rnam par smin pa bzhin/ /sa gsum rjes 'brel dri ma rnams/ /sa 'dam gos bzhin shes bya ste/ /bdag nyid chen po rdo rje lta'i/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis gzhom bya yin/ /de ltar chags sogs dri ma dgu/ /pad+ma la sogs dag dang mtshungs/ /rang bzhin gsum gyis bsdus phyir khams/ /sangs rgyas sogs dang chos mtshungs so/ /'di yi rang bzhin chos sku dang / /de bzhin nyid dang rigs kyang ste/ /de ni dpe gsum gcig dang ni/ /lnga rnams kyis ni shes par bya/ /chos sku rnam gnyis shes bya ste/ /chos dbyings shin tu dri med dang / /de yi rgyu mthun zab pa dang / /sna tshogs tshul ni ston pa'orka/ /'jig rten 'das phyir 'jig rten na/ /'di la dpe ni mi dmigs pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang khams/ /'dra ba nyid du bstan pa yin/ /phra mo zab mo'i tshul bstan ni/ /sbrang rtsi ro gcig pa bzhin te/ /rnam pa sna tshogs tshul bstan ni/ /sna tshogs sbubs snying 21

bzhin shes bya/ /rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa dang / /dge dang rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ /de bzhin nyid 'di gser gyi ni/ /gzugs dang mtshungs par brjod pa yin/ /gter dang 'bras bu'i shing bzhin du/ /rigs de rnam gnyis shes bya ste/ /thog med rang bzhin gnas pa dang —/ /yang dag blang ba mchog nyid do/ /rigs 'di gnyis las sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku gsum thob par 'dod pa yin/ /dang po'i sku ni dang po ste/ /gnyis pa yis ni phyi ma gnyis/ /ngo bo nyid sku mdzes pa niske/ /rin chen sku 'drar shes bya ste/ /rang bzhin gyis ni byas min dang ne/ /yon tan rin chen gter yin phyir/ /chos chen rgyal srid che ldan phyir/ /rdzogs longs 'khor los sgyur bzhin no/ /gzugs brnyan gyi ni rang bzhin phyir/ /sprul pa gser gyi gzugs lta bu/ /rang byung rnams kyi don dam de/ /dad pa nyid kyis rtogs bya yin/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba/ /mig med pas ni mthong ba med/ /'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /gzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag lta/ /yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ /rnam dbye bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /glo bur dag gis khams stong gi/ /rnam dbye med pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /bla med chos kyis stong ma yin/ /sprin dang mi lam sgyu bzhin de dang der/ /shes bya thams cad rnam kun stong pa zhes/ /gsungs nas yang 'dir rgyal rnams sems can la/ /22

sangs rgyas snying po yod ces ci ste gsungs/ /sems zhum sems can dman la brnyas pa dang / /yang dag min 'dzin yang dag chos la skur/ /bdag cag lhag pa'i skyon lnga gang dag la/ /yod pa de dag de spang don du gsungs/ /yang dag mtha' ni 'dus byas kyis/ /rnam pa thams cad dben pa ste/ /nyon mongs las dang rnam smin don/ /sprin la sogs pa bzhin du brjod/ /nyon mongs sprin 'dra bya ba yin/ /las ni rmi lam longs spyod bzhin/ /nyon mongs las kyi rnam par smin/ /phung po sgyu ma sprul pa bzhin/ /sngar ni de ltar rnam bzhag nas/ /slar yang bla ma'i rgyud 'dir ni/ /nyes pa lnga dag spang ba'i phyir/ /khams yod nyid ces bstan pa yin/ /'di ltar de ni ma thos par/ /bdag la brnyas pa'i nyes pa yis/ /sems ni zhum pa 'ga' zhig nas/ /byang chub sems ni skye mi 'gyur/ /gang la byang chub sems skyes pas/ /bdag ni mchog ces rlom pa na/ /byang chub sems ma skyes pa la/ /dman pa'i 'du shes rab tu 'jug /de ltar sems pa de la ni/ /yang dag shes pa mi skye ba/ /des na yang dag min 'dzin cing / /yang dag don ni rig mi 'gyur/ /bcos ma glo bur ba nyid phyir/ /sems can skyon de yang dag min/ /yang dag nyes de bdag med pa/ /yon tan rang bzhin dag pa yin/ /yang dag min pa'i nyes 'dzin cing ske/ /yang dag yon tan skur 'debs pa/ /blo ldan bdag dang 23

sems can la/ /mtshungs mthong byams pa thob mi 'gyur/ /'di ltar de ni thos pa las/ /spro dang ston pa bzhin gus dang / /shes rab ye shes byams chen skye/ /chos lnga skye phyir de las ni/ /kha na ma tho med mtshungs ltaske/ /skyon med yon tan ldan pa dang / /bdag dang sems can mtshungs byams las/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni myur du 'thob/ /theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bsna bcos dkon mchog gi rigs rnam par dbye ba las/de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i skabs te dang po'o// //dag thob bral ba rang bzhin don/ /de brten zab dang rgya che dang //bdag nyid chen po de yang ni/ /ji srid dus dang ji lta nyid/ /ngo bo rgyu dang 'bras bu dang / /las dang ldan la 'jug pa dang / /de rtag bsam mi khyab nyid kyis/ /sangs rgyas sa ni mnyam par gzhag /rang bzhin 'od gsal zhes brjod gang yin nyi dang mkha' bzhin glo bur gyi/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sprin tshogs stug po'i sgrib pa yis ni bsgribs gyur pa/ /dri med sangs rgyas yon tan kun ldan rtag brtan g.yung drung sangs rgyas nyid/ /de ni chos la mi rtog rma 'byed ye shes dag la brten nas 'thob—/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni dbyer med pa/ /dag pa'i chos kyis rab phye ba/ /nyi ma mkha' bzhin ye shes dang / /spangs pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid do/ /'od gsal byas min dbyer med par/ /'jug can gang gā'i klung gi ni/ /rdul las 'das phyir sangs rgyas kyi/ /chos rnams kun 24

dang ldan pa nyid/ /rang bzhin gyis ni ma grub dang / /khyab dang glo bur ba nyid kyis/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa der/ /sprin dang 'dra bar brjod pa yin/ /sgrib pa gnyis dang bral ba yi/ /rgyu ni ye shes gnyis yin te/ /mi rtog pa dang de yi ni/ /rjes thob de ni ye shes 'dod/ /dri med chu ldan rim rgyas pad+mas khebs pa'i mtsho bzhin dang / /sgra gcan kha nas thar ba'i zla ba nya ba lta bu dang / /sprin tshogs nyon mongs dag las bral ba'i nyi ma lta bur ni/ /dri med yon tan ldan phyir 'od zer snang ldan de nyid do/ /thub pa khyu mchog sbrang rtsi snying po dang //rin chen gser dang gter dang ljon pa bzhin/ /dri med rin chen bde gshegs sku dang ni/ /sa bdag gser gyi gzugs 'dra rgyal ba nyid / /chu mtsho sogs bzhin 'dod chags sogs/ /glo bur nyon mongs dag pa ni/ /mdor na mi rtog ye shes kyi/ /'bras bu yin par rab tu brjod/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas sku ni nges thob pa/ /de ni rjes las thob pa yi/ /ye shes 'bras bu yin par stonaske/ /'dod chags rdul ni spang phyir dang / /gdul bya yi ni pad+ma la/ /bsam gtan chu ni 'bab phyir de/ /chu dag rdzing dang mtshungs pa nyid//zhe sdang sgra gcan las grol bas/ /snying rje byams chen 'od zer gyis/ /'gro ba khyab pa'i phyir na de/ /dri med zla ba nya ba bzhin/ /gti mug sprin las rnam grol ba/ /'gro bar ye shes 'od zer gyis/ /mun pa 25

sel phyir sangs rgyas nyid/ /de ni dri med nyi ma bzhin/ /mi mnyam mnyam pa'i chos phyir dang / /dam chos ro ni sbyin mdzad dang / /shun pa dang ni bral phyir de/ /bde gshegs sbrang rtsi snying po bzhin/ /dag phyir yon tan rdzas kyis ni/ /dbul ba sel bar byed phyir dang / /rnam grol 'bras bu 'byin byed phyir/ /gser dang gter dang ljon pa bzhinaske/ /rin chen chos kyi sku phyir dang / /rkang gnyis bdag po'i mchog phyir dang / /rin chen gzugs kyi rnam pa'i phyir/ /de ni rin chen rgyal gser bzhin/ /zag pa med khyab 'jig med chos can te/ /brtan zhi rtag pa 'pho med gnas yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mkha' bzhin dag pa yi/ /dbang po drug don nyams su myong ba'i rgyu/ /'byung med gzugs don blta dang gtam bzang ni/ /gtsang ma mnyen dang bde gshegs tshul khrims kyi/ /dri gtsang snom dang 'phags chen dam chos ro/ /myang dang ting 'dzin reg bde nyams myong dang / /rang gi ngo bo nyid kyi zab pa'i tshul/ /rtogs pa'i rgyur gyur zhib mor bsams pa na/ /don dam bde mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /nam mkha' bzhin du rgyu mtshan rnams dang bral/ /mdor na ye shes gnyis po yi/ /las su 'di ni shes bya ste/ /grol ba'i sku ni rdzogs pa dang / /chos kyi sku ni sbyong ba'o/ /rnam grol chos kyi sku dag ni/ /rnam gnyis rnam gcig shes bya ste/ /zag pa med phyir khyab pa'i phyir/ /'dus ma 26

byas phyir gnas nyid phyir/ /nyon mongs rnams ni bag chags dang / /bcas pa 'gags phyir zag med de/ /chags med thogs pa med pa'i phyir / /ye shes khyab pa nyid du 'dod/ /gtan du 'jig pa med pa yi/ /rang bzhin yin phyir 'dus ma byas/ /'jig med nyid ni bstan pa ste//brtan sogs rnams kyis de bshad do/ /'jig pa rnam bzhir shes bya ste / /brtan sogs dag las bzlog phyir ro/ /myags dang rnam 'gyur chad pa dang / /bsam mi khyab 'gyur 'pho ba ste/ /de med phyir dang brtan zhi dang / /rtag dang 'pho med shes par bya/ /dri med shes de dkar po yi/ /chos kyi rten yin phyir na gnas/ /ji ltar rgyu min nam mkha' ni/ /gzugs mthong ba dang sgra dang dri/ /ro dang reg dang chos rnams ni/ /thos la sogs pa'i rgyu yin ltar/ /de bzhin sku gnyis sgrib med pa'i/ /sbyor bas bstan pa'i dbang don la/ /zag pa med pa'i yon tan dag /skye ba yi ni rgyu yin no/ /bsam med rtag brtan zhi ba g.yung drung nyid/ /rab tu zhi khyab rtog bral nam mkha' bzhin/ /chags med kun tu thogs med rtsub reg spangs/ /lta gzung med dge sangs rgyas dri ma med/ /rnam grol chos kyi sku dag gis/ /rang dang gzhan gyi don bstan te/ /rang gzhan don rten de la ni/ /bsam mi khyab sogs yon tan ldan/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yul/ /sangs rgyas shes gsum yul min phyir/ /ye shes lus can rnams kyis 27

ni—/ /bsam mi khyab par rtogs par bya/ /phra phyir thos pa'i yul min te—/ /don dam yin phyir bsam bya'i min/ /chos nyid zab phyir 'jig rten pa'i/ /bsgom pa la sogs yul ma yin/ /gang phyir gzugs la dmus long bzhin/ /byis pas de sngon mthong ma myong / /btsas pa'i khyim nas bu chung gis/ /nyi ma'i gzugs bzhin 'phags pas kyang / /skye dang bral phyir rtag pa ste/ /'gag med phyir na brtan pa yin/ /gnyis med phyir de zhi ba ste/ /g.yung drung chos nyid gnas phyir ro/ /rab ni 'gog pa'i bden pa'i phyir/ /thams cad rtog phyir khyab pa nyid / /gnas pa med phyir rtog med de/ /nyon mongs spangs phyir chags pa med/ /shes bya'i sgrib kun dag pa'i phyir/ /thams cad du ni thogs pa med/ /gnyis med las su rung ba'i phyir/ /rtsub pa'i reg dang bral ba yin/ /de gzugs med phyir bltar med de/ /mtshan ma med phyir gzung du med/ /dge ba rang bzhin dag pa'i phyir/ /dri med dri ma spangs phyir ro/ /thog ma dbus mtha' med cing rnam dbyer med//gnyis med gsum bral dri med rnam rtog med/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin gang yin de rtogs pa/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor pa yis mthong / /gzhal med gang gā'i bye ma las 'das pa/ /bsam med mnyam med yon tan rnams dang ldan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dri med dbyings de ni/ /bag chags bcas pa'i nyes pa rnams spangs pa'o/ /28

sna tshogs dam chos 'od zer mnga' ba'i skus/ /'gro ba'i rnam grol don grub la brtson pa/ /mdzad pa yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal bzhin te/ /sna tshogs dngos kyang de yi rang bzhin min/ /'jig rten zhi ba'i lam la 'jug pa dang / /rab tu smin dang lung ston rgyu yi gzugs/ /gang yin de yang 'dir ni rtag gnas te/ /nam mkha'i khams su gzugs kyi khams bzhin no/ /rang byung rnams kyi thams cad mkhyen/ /sangs rgyas nyid ces gang brjod pa/ /mchog tu mya ngan 'das bsam med/ /dgra bcom so so'i bdag gyur pa/ /de dbye zab dang rgya che dang / /bdag nyid chen po'i yon tan gyi/ /chos kyis rab phye rang bzhin la/ /sogs pa'i sku gsum dag gis 'jug /de la sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni/ /ngo bo nyid sku mtshan nyid lnga/ /mdor na yon tan lnga dang ni/ /ldan pa nyid du rig par bya/ /'dus ma byas shing rnam dbyer med/ /mtha' gnyis dag ni rnam par spangs/ /nyon mongs shes bya snyoms 'jug gi /sgrib gsum las ni nges grol te/ /dri med rnam par rtog med dang / /rnal 'byor rnams kyi yul yin phyir/ /chos dbyings ngo bo nyid kyis ni//dag pa'i phyir na 'od gsal ba/ /gzhal med grangs med bsam med pa—/ /mnyam med dag pa'i mthar thug pa'i/ /yon tan rnams dang yang dag par/ /ngo bo nyid kyi sku ldan te/ /rgya che'i phyir dang grangs med phyir/ /rtog ge'i yul ni min phyir dang / /'ba' zhig bag chags 29

bcas spang phyir/ /gzhal med la sogs go rim bzhin/ /sna tshogs chos la rdzogs longs spyod/ /rang bzhin chos ni snang phyir dang / /thugs rje dag pa'i rgyu mthun pa/ /'gro don rgyun mi 'chad phyir dang / /rnam pa rtog med lhun grub par/ /'dod pa ji bzhin yongs skong phyir//yid bzhin nor bu'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /rdzogs par longs spyod rnam par gnas / /brjod ston mdzad rgyun mi 'chad dang / /mngon par 'du byed med pa dang / /de yi ngo bo min ston la/ /'dir ni sna tshogs rnam lngar ston/ /ji ltar tshon ni sna tshogs kyis/ /nor bu de dngos min snang ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro rkyen sna tshogs bas/ /khyab bdag de dngos min par snang / /thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen/ /'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni/ /chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ /sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis/ /skye ba mngon par skye ba dang / /dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang / /lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang / /bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang / /btsun mo'i 'khor dgyes rol pa dang ske/ /nges 'byung dka' ba spyad pa dang / /byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang / /bdud sde 'joms dang rdzogs par ni/ /byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang / /mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams/ /yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal bdag med dang / /zhi ba'i sgra yis thabs mkhyen pas/ /30

sems can srid gsum skyo bskyed nas/ /mya ngan 'das la rab 'jug mdzad—/ /zhi ba'i lam la rab zhugs pa/ /mya ngan 'das thob 'du shes can—/ /dam chos pad+ma dkar la sogs/ /chos kyi de nyid bstan pa yis—/ /de dag sngar 'dzin las bzlog ste/ /thabs dang shes rab yongs bzung pas/ /theg pa mchog la smin mdzad de/ /byang chab mchog tu lung bstan to/ /zab dang mthu ni phun tshogs dang / /byis pa'i don mthun rab 'dren phyir/ /'di dag grangs bzhin zab pa dang ske/ /rgya che bdag nyid che zhes bya/ /'dir ni dang po chos sku ste/ /phyi ma dag ni gzugs kyi sku/ /nam mkha' la ni gzugs gnas bzhin//dang po la ni tha ma gnas/ /rgyu mtha' yas dang sems can zad med dang / /brtse dang 'phrul dang mkhyen dang phun tshogs ldan/ /chos kyi dbang phyug 'chi ba'i bdud bcom dang / /ngo bo med phyir 'jig rten mgon pos brtag /lus dang srog dang longs spyod rnams/ /btang nas dam chos 'dzin phyir dang / /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /dang po dam bcas mthar phyin phyir/ /sangs rgyas nyid nas gtsang ba dang —/ /dag pa'i thugs rje rab 'jug phyir/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa ston par ni/ /de yis gnas par spyod pa'i phyir/ /mkhyen pas 'khor dang mya ngan 'das/ /gnyis su 'dzin las grol ba'i phyir/ /rtag tu bsam yas ting 'dzin gyi/ /bde ba phun sum tshogs ldan phyir/ /'jig rten 31

na ni spyod pa na/ /'jig rten chos kyis gos med phyir/ /'chi med zhi ba'i gnas thob la/ /'chi bdud rgyu ba med pa'i phyir/ /'dus ma byas pa'i rang bzhin gyi/ /thub pa gdod nas rab zhi'i phyir/ /rtag pa skyabs med rnams kyi ni/ /skyabs la sogs par 'thad phyir ro/ /dang po yi ni rgyu bdun gyis/ /gzugs kyi sku yi rtag nyid de/ /phyi ma gsum gyis ston pa ni/ /chos kyi sku yi rtag pa nyid/ /ngag yul min phyir don dam gyis bsdus phyir/ /rtogs gnas min phyir dpe las 'das pa'i phyir—/ /bla na med phyir srid zhis ma bsdus phyir/ /rgyal yul 'phags rnams kyis kyang bsam mi khyab/ /bsam med brjod du med phyir te/ /brjod med don dam yin phyir ro/ /don dam brtag bya min phyir te/ /brtag min rjes dpag bya min phyir/ /dpag min bla na med pa'i phyir//bla na med pa ma bsdus phyir/ /ma bsdus gnas pa med phyir te/ /yon tan skyon rtog med phyir ro/ /rgyu lnga dag gis phra ba'i phyir/ /chos sku bsam mi khyab pa ste/ /drug pas de yi dngos min phyir/ /gzugs sku bsam mi khyab pa'o/ /bla med ye shes thugs rje che sogs yon tan gyis—/ /yon tan pha rol byon pa'i rgyal ba bsam mi khyab/ /des na rang byung rnams kyi tha ma'i tshul 'di ni/ /drang srong chen po dbang thob rnams kyis kyang rig min/ /theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos dkon mchog gi rigs rnam par dbye ba las/ byang chub kyi skabs te 32

gnyis pa'o// //rang don gzhan don don dam sku dang ni/ /de la brten pa kun rdzob sku nyid de/ /bral dang rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /yon tan dbye ba drug cu bzhi 'di dag /bdag nyid kyi ni 'byor pa'i gnasaske/ /dam pa'i don gyi sku yin te/ /drang srong rnams kyi brda yi sku/ /pha rol phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas/ /dang po'i sku ni stobs la sogs/ /bral ba'i yon tan rnams dang ldan/ /gnyis pa skyes bu chen po'i mtshanaske/ /rnam smin yon tan dag dang ldan/ /stobs nyid ma rig sgrib la rdo rje bzhin/ /mi 'jigs nyid ni 'khor du seng ge bzhin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ma 'dres mkha' bzhin te/ /thub pa'i bstan pa rnam gnyis chu zla bzhin/ /gnas dang gnas min las rnams kyi/ /rnam smin dang ni dbang po dang / /khams rnams dang ni mos pa dang / /kun 'gro'i lam dang bsam gtan sogs/ /nyon mongs dri ma med pa dang //gnas ni rjes su dran pa dang / /lha yi mig dang zhi ba dag /mkhyen pa'i stobs ni rnam pa bcu/ /gnas dang gnas min rnam smin khams dang 'gro ba'i mos pa sna tshogs dang / /nyon mongs rnam byang dbang po'i tshogs dang sngon gnas rjes su dran pa dang / /lha yi mig dang zag pa zad tshul mi shes go cha rtsig brtan dang / /shing rnams 'bigs dang 'jig dang gcod phyir stobs gang yin pa rdo rje bzhin/ /chos sku 33

rdzogs par byang chub dang / /gegs ni 'gog par byed pa dang / /lam ston pa dang 'gog ston la/ /mi 'jigs pa ni rnam pa bzhi/ /bdag gzhan shes bya'i dngos po rnam kun shes dang shes mdzad phyir/ /spang dngos spangs dang spang mdzad phyir dang brten bya bsten pa'i phyir/ /thob bya bla med shin tu dri med thob dang thob mdzad phyir/ /rang gzhan don ldan gsung phyir drang srong gang du'ang thogs pa med/ /ri dwags dbang po ji ltar nags mthar rtag 'jig med/ /ri dwags rnams la skrag pa med par rgyu ba ltar/ /de bzhin tshogs nang thub pa'i dbang po seng ge yang / /legs gnas ltos med brtan pa'i rtsal dang ldan par gnas / /'khrul dang ca co mi mnga' ste/ /ston la dran pa nyams mi mnga' / /mnyam par ma bzhag thugs mi mnga'/ /'du shes sna tshogs kyang mi mnga'/ /ma brtags btang snyoms mi mnga' ste/ /'dun dang brtson 'grus dran pa dang / /shes rab rnam grol rnam grol gyi/ /ye shes gzigs pa nyams mi mnga'/ /las rnams ye shes sngon 'gro dang / /dus la ye shes sgrib pa med/ /de ltar bco brgyad 'di dang gzhan/ /ston pa'i ma 'dres yon tan yin/ /'khrul dang ca co bsnyel dang thugs g.yo tha dad kyi ni 'du shes dang / /ngang gi btang snyoms drang srong la med 'dun pa dang ni brtson 'grus dang / /dran pa rnam dag dri med shes rab rtag tu rnam par grol ba dang / /shes bya'i don kun 34

gzigs pa grol ba'i ye shes las ni nyams mi nga / /gang gi las gsum thams cad ye shes sngon 'gro'i rjes su 'jug pa dang / /dus gsum rtag tu thogs pa med pa mkhyen pa rgya chen 'jug pa ste/ /gang rtogs 'gro bar 'jigs med dam chos 'khor lo chen po rab bskor ba/ /thugs rje chen po dang ldan rgyal ba nyid de sangs rgyas rnams kyis brnyes—/ /sa sogs la yod chos gang yin pa'i chos nyid de ni nam mkha'i min/ /nam mkha'i mtshan nyid sgrib med la sogs mtshan nyid gang de gzugs la med/ /sa chu me rlung nam mkha' mtshungs pa 'jig rten dag na thun mong ste/ /ma dres nyid ni rdul phran tsam yang 'jig rten dag na thun mong min/ /legs gnas 'khor lo'i mtshan pa dang //yangs shing zhabs long mi mngon dang / /sor mo ring dang phyag zhabs ni / /dra ba yis ni 'brel pa dang / /pags 'jam gzhon sha can legs nyidaske/ /sku ni bdun dag mtho ba dang / /byin pa e na ya 'dra gsang / /glang po bzhin du sbubs su nub/ /ro stod seng ge 'dra ba dang / /thal gong bar med rgyas pa dang / /dpung mgo legs zlum phyag 'jam zhing / /zlum zhing mtho dman med pa dang / /phyag ring yongs su dag pa'i sku/ /'od kyi dkyi' 'khor dang ldan dang / /mgrin pa dri med dung 'dra dang //'gram pa ri dwags rgyal po 'dra/ /tshems ni bzhi bcu mnyam pa dang / /rab dag tshems thags bzang dang / /rnam dag tshems mnyam nyid dang 35

niske/ /mche ba rab mchog dkar ba nyid/ /ljags ring mtha' med bsam med pa/ /ro bro ba yi mchog nyid dang / /rang byung ka la ping ka yi/ /sgra dang tshangs pa'i dbyangs nyid dang / /spyan bzang ut+pal khyu mchog rdzi 'dra dang / /zhal mjes dri med mdzod spu dkar ldan dang / /gtsug tor dbu ldan dag cing srab pa dang / /pags pa gser gyi mdog 'dra sems can mchog /ba spu legs phra 'jam zhing re re nas/ /sku yi gyen du g.yas phyogs 'khyil ba dang / /dbu skra dri med rin chen mthon mthing bzhin/ /n+ya gro rdzogs par ljon shing dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /kun tu bzang po dpe med drang srong che/ /sred med bu yi stobs mnga' mkhregs pa'i sku/ /bsam mi khyab par sum cu rtsa gnyis po/ /'di dag ston pas mi dbang mtshan du gsungs/ /ji ltar sprin med mkha' yi zla ba'i gzugs/ /ston ka'i chu sngon mtshor ni mthong ba ltar/ /de bzhin rgyal sras tshogs kyi khyab bdag gzugs/ /rdzogs sangs dkyil 'khor nang du mthong bar 'gyur/ /yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi po/ /'di dag so sor rgyu bcas te/ /go rim ji bzhin rin chen gyi/ /mdo yi rjes 'brang shes par bya/ /mi phyed pa dang mi zhan dang / /mtshungs pa med phyir g.yo med phyir/ /rdo rje seng ge mkha' dag pa'i/ /chu yi zla ba'i dpes bstan to/ /stobs sogs rnams las stobs drug dang / /gsum dang gcig gis rim pa bzhin/ /shes bya snyoms par 'jug pa dang / /36

bag chags bcas pa kun bsal bas/ /go cha rtsig pa shing bzhin du/ /phug dang bshig dang bcad phyir ro/ /brling dang snying brtan mi phyed pas—/ /drang srong stobs ni rdo rje 'dra/ /gang phyir brling ba snying po'i phyir—/ /gang phyir snying po brtan pa'i phyir/ /gang phyir brtan pa mi phyed phyir / /mi phyed phyir na rdo rje bzhin/ /'jigs pa med phyir ltos med phyiraske/ /brtan phyir rtsal ni phun tshogs pas/ /thub pa seng ge seng ge bzhin—/ /'khor gyi tshogs su 'jigs mi mnga'/ /kun mngon mkhyen pas gang las kyang / /'jigs med par ni rnam par gnas/ /dag pa'i sems can dang yang bdag /mi mnyam gzigs phyir ltos pa med/ /thugs ni chos rnams thams cad la/ /rtse gcig phyir na brtan pa nyid/ /mchog tu ma rig bag chags kyi/ /sa las brgal phyir rtsal ldan no/ /'jig rten nyan thos mtha' gcig tu/ /spyod dang blo ldan rang byung rnams—/ /gong nas gong du blo dag ni/ /phra phyir dpe ni rnam pa lnga/ /'jig rten kun gyi nyer 'tsho'i phyir/ /sa chu me rlung rnams dang mtshungs—/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /mtshan nyid las 'das nam mkha' bzhin/ /de dag yon tan sum cu ni/ /gnyis 'di chos skus rab phye ste/ /nor bu rin chen 'od mdog dang / /dbyibs bzhin dbye ba med phyir ro/ /mthong na tshim byed yon tan gang / /sum cu rtsa gnyis zhes bya ba/ /sprul pa chos la rdzogs par ni/ /longs spyod 37
