rdzogs sku gnyis la brten/ /dag las ring dang nye rnams las/ /'jig rten rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /chu dang nam mkha' zla gzugs bzhin—/ /de mthong ba ni rnam pa gnyis/ /theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos dkon mchog gi rigs rnam par dbye ba las/ /yon tan gyi skabs te gsum pa'o// //gdul bya'i khams dang gdul ba'i thabs dang ni/ /gdul bya'i khams kyi gdul bya'i bya ba dang / /de yi yul dang dus su gshegs pa la—/ /khyab bdag rtag tu lhun gyis grub par 'jug /yon tan rin chen mchog tshogs dang ldan ye shes chu mtsho bsod nams ye shes nyi 'od can—/ /theg pa ma lus nges par bsgrubs te mtha' dang dbus med rgya chen nam mkha' ltar khyab pa/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni yon tan dri ma med gter sems can kun la khyad med rnam gzigs nas/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sprin gyi dra ba sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje'i rlung gis rnam par gtor/ /gang zhig gang gis gdul ba yi/ /bya gang gang du gang gi tshe/ /de yi rnam rtog skye med phyir/ /thub pa rtag tu lhun gyis grub/ /gdul bya'i khams ni gang zhig gi /gdul ba'i thabs mang gang gang gisaske/ /gdul bya'i bya gang gang du ni/ /gang tshe yul dang dus de dag /nges 'byin de yi ston pa dang / /de 'bras de yi yongs 'dzin dang / /de sgrib de gcod rkyen la ni/ /rnam par rtog pa med phyir ro/ /nges 38

par 'byin pa sa bcu ste/ /tshogs gnyis dag ni de yi rgyu/ /de 'bras byang chub mchog yin te/ /byang chub sems can yongs su 'dzin/ /de sgrib mtha' yas nyon mongs dang / /nye ba'i nyon mongs bag chags so/ /dus kun du ni de 'joms pa'i/ /rkyen ni thugs rje chen po yin/ /gnas drug po ni 'di dag rnams/ /go rim ji bzhin rgya mtsho dang / /nyi ma dang ni nam mkha'i gter/ /sprin dang rlung bzhin shes par bya/ /shes chu yon na rin chen dang / /ldan phyir sa rnams rgya mtsho bzhin/ /sems can thams cad nyer 'tsho'i phyir/ /tshogs gnyis dag ni nyi ma bzhin—/ /rgya che mtha' dang dbus med phyir/ /byang chub nam mkha'i khams bzhin no/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs chos nyid phyir/ /sems can khams ni gter dang 'dra/ /glo bur khyab dang ma grub phyir/ /de yi nyon mongs sprin tshogs bzhin/ /de 'thor bar ni nyer gnas phyir/ /thugs rje mi bzad rlung dang 'dra/ /gzhan gyi dbang gis nges 'byung dang —/ /bdag dang sems can mtshungs gzigs dang / /mdzad pa yongs su ma rdzogs phyir/ /'khor ba srid du mdzad mi 'chad/ /brgya sbyin rnga sprin tshangs pa dang / /nyi ma nor bu rin chen bzhin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgra brnyan bzhin/ /nam mkha' dang ni sa bzhin no/ /ji ltar bai ḍūr dag pa yi/ /rang bzhin sa steng 'dir 'gyur te/ /dag phyir lha yi dbang po der/ /lha yi bu mo'i tshogs dang bcas/ /39

rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dang / /lha gnas de las gzhan dag dang / /de yi gzhal yas sna tshogs dang / /lha rdzas rnam mang de mthong ngo —/ /de nas skyes pa bud med tshogs/ /sa yi steng na gnas pa rnams/ /snang ba de ni mthong gyur te/ /nged kyang ring por mi thogs par/ /lha dbang 'di 'drar gyur cig ces/ /de 'dra'i smon lam 'debs byed cing —/ /de thob don du dge ba ni/ /yang dag blangs te gnas par gyuraske/ /de dag dge ba'i las des ni/ /'di snang tshul zhes de lta bur//shes pa med kyang sa steng nas/ /'phos te lha ru skye bar 'gyur/ /snang ba de ni shin tu yang / /rtog pa med cing g.yo ba med/ /de lta mod kyi sa steng na/ /don chen gyis ni nye bar gnas/ /de bzhin dad sogs dri med can/ /dad sogs yon tan bsgom pa yi/ /rang sems la snang rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa dang / /'chag pa dang ni bzhengs pa dang / /bzhugs pa dang ni gzims pa dang / /spyod lam sna tshogs mdzad pa can/ /zhi ba'i chos ni gsung ba dang / /mi gsung mnyam par bzhag gyur pa/ /cho 'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /mdzad pa gzi mdangs chen po can/ /sems can rnams kyis mthong bar 'gyur/ /de mthong nas kyang 'dod ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas nyid ces rab sbyor te/ /de rgyu yang dag blangs nas ni/ /'dod pa'i go 'phang thob par byed/ /snang ba de ni shin tu yang / /rtog med g.yo ba 40

med pa nyid/ /de lta na yang 'jig rten na/ /don chen pos ni nye bar gnas—/ /'di ni rang sems snang ba zhes/ /so so'i skye bos mi shes modatso/ /de lta na yang gzugs mthong ste/ /de dag la ni don yod 'gyur / /rim gyis de mthong la brten nas/ /theg pa 'di la gnas pa rnams / /nang gi dang po chos sku ni/ /ye shes mig gis mthong bar 'gyur / /ji ltar sa kun nyam nga'i gnas gzhan dang bral dri med be+e ḍūr+ya / /gsal mdzes nor bu'i yon tan dri bral dpal ldan steng ni mnyam gyur te/ /dag phyir der ni lha dag sna tshogs lha dbang lha yi gzugs shar ste/ /rim gyis sa yi yon tan bral phyir de ni slar yang mi mthong 'gyur/ /de dngos thob phyir bsnyen gnas brtul zhugs nges par sbyin sogs la phyogs pa/ /bud med skyes tshogs smon pa'i sems kyis me tog la sogs 'thor ba ltar/ /dag pa bai ḍūr+ya 'dra'i sems la snang ba'i thub dbang thob bya'i phyir/ /rab dga'i sems ldan rgyal ba'i sras rnams de bzhin sems rab skyed par byed/ /ji ltar be+e ḍūr sa gzhi gtsang ma la/ /lha dbang lus kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro sems sa gzhi gtsang ma la/ /thub pa'i dbang po'i sku yi gzugs brnyan 'char/ /'gro bar gzugs brnyan 'char nub rnyog med dang / /rnyog pa'i rang sems rab 'jug dbang gis 'jug /ji ltar 'jig rten dag na gzugs snang ltar/ /de bzhin yod dang zhig 41

ces de mi ltar/ /ji ltar lha nang lha rnams kyi/ /sngon gyi dkar po'i mthu yis ni/ /'bad dang gnas dang yig gzugs dang / /rnam par rtog pa med bzhin du/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal bdag med dang / /zhi ba'i sgra yis bag med pa'i/ /lha rnams thams cad yang dang yang / /chos kyi rngas ni skul byed ltar/ /de bzhin khyab bdag 'bad sogs dang / /bral yang 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /sangs rgyas gsung gis khyab mdzad de/ /skal ldan rnams la chos ston to/ /ji ltar lha nang lha rnams kyi/ /rnga sgras rang gi las las byung / /de bzhin 'jig rten thub pa'i chos/ /gsung ba rang gi las las byung / /'bad nas lus dang sems bral ba'i—/ /sgra de ji ltar zhi sgrub ltar/ /de bzhin 'bad sogs dang bral ba'i—/ /chos de zhi ba sgrub par byed/ /ji ltar lha yi grong na rnga sgra'i rgyus byung mi 'jigs sbyin pa ni/ /nyon mongs g.yul du 'jug tshe lha min dpung rgyal rtsed mo sel ba ltar/ /de bzhin 'jig rten dag na bsam gtan gzugs med la sogs rgyus byung ba/ /sems can nyon mongs sdug bsngal rab 'joms zhi ba bla med lam tshul brjod/ /gang phyir skye kun pha nyid dang / /phan bde cho 'phrul gsum ldan pa/ /de phyir thub dbyangs lha rdzas kyi/ /sil snyan rnams las khyad par 'phags/ /lhar ni rnga yi sgra chen po/ /sar gnas rnams kyi rnar mi 'gro/ /sangs rgyas rnga sgra 'khor ba yi/ /sa 'og 'jig rten dag tu 'gro/ /lhar ni lha yi 42

sil snyan bye ba mang / /'dod me mngon par 'phel ba'i don du sgrog /thugs rje'i bdag nyid rnams kyi dbyangs gcig kyang / /sdug bsngal me rab zhi ba'i don du 'jug /lhar ni mdzes shing yid dbang sil snyan sgra / /sems kyi rgod pa 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i rgyu/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung / /ting 'dzin sems gtod bsam pa skul byed nyid/ /mdor na ma lus 'jig rten khams su yang / /lha dang sa gnas bde ba'i rgyu gang yin/ /de ni ma lus 'jig rten khyab snang ba/ /dbyangs nyid la ni rab tu brten par brjod/ /ji ltar rna ba dang bral bas/ /phra mo'i sgra ni mi myong zhing / /thams cad lha yi rnam bar yang / /rna lam du ni mi 'gro bzhin/ /de bzhin chos phra mchog tu niske/ /zhib mo'i ye shes spyod yul yang / /nyon mongs med yid 'ga' zhig gi /rna ba'i lam du 'gyur ba yin/ /ji ltar dbyar gyi dus na sprin—/ /lo tog phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu/ /chu yi phung po 'bad med par—/ /sa la rgyun du 'bebs pa ltar/ /de bzhin thugs rje'i sprin las ni—/ /rgyal ba'i dam chos chu yi char/ /'gro ba'i dge ba'i lo tog rgyu/ /rnam par rtog pa med par 'bebs/ /ji ltar 'jig rten dge ba'i lam 'jug na/ /rlung skyes chu char sprin gyis 'bebs pa ltar/ /de bzhin brtse rlung 'gro dge mngon 'phel phyir/ /sangs rgyas sprin las dam chos char pa 'bebs/ /srid la mkhyen dang brtse chen 'gyur ba 43

dang ske/ /mi 'gyur mi gos nam mkha'i dkyil gnas pa/ /ting 'dzin gzungs chu dri med snying po can/ /thub dbang sprin ni dge ba'i lo tog rgyuske/ /ji ltar bsil dang zhim dang 'jam pa dang / /yang ba'i chu ni sprin de las thon pa/ /sa la ba tshwa la sogs gnas 'brel bas/ /shin tu mang po'i ror ni 'gyur ba bzhin/ /de bzhin 'phags pa'i yan lag brgyad chu'i char/ /rab yangs brtse sprin snying po las thon pa/ /'gro ba'i rgyud kyi gnas kyi dbye ba las/ /rnam pa mang po'i ro dang ldan par 'gyur/ /theg pa mchog la dang ba dang / /bar ma dang ni sdang ba yi / /phung po gsum ni mi dag dang / /rma bya dang ni yi dwags 'dra/ /dpyid mthar sprin med pa ni mi dang mkha' mi rgyu ba'i bya dag dang / /dbyar tshe sa la char 'babs pa na yi dwags dag ni sdug pa ltar/ /snying rje'i sprin tshogs dag gis chos chu byung dang ma byung ba las kyang / /chos 'dod pa dang chos la sdang ba'i 'jig rten dag na dpe de nyid/ /thigs pa rags 'bebs rdo tshan dang ni rdo rje'i me ni 'bebs pa na/ /srog chags phra dang ri sul song ba dag la ji ltar sprin ltos med/ /phra dang rgya chen rigs pa'i tshul gyis mkhyen pa dang ni brtse ba'i sprin/ /nyon mongs dag 'gyur bdag lta'i bag nyal dag la rnam kun ltos pa med—/ /'khor ba'i skye 'chi thog ma med der 'gro ba'i lam ni rnam pa lnga—/ /mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med bzhin 'gro lnga dag na bde ba med/ /44

de yi sdug bsngal rtag tu mes mtshon rgya tshwa la sogs reg skyes bzhin/ /thugs rje'i sprin las dam chos char chen de rab zhi byed rab tu 'bebs—/ /lha la 'chi 'pho mi la yongs tshol sdug bsngal zhes byar rtogs pa'i phyir/ /shes rab ldan pa lha mi'i dbang phyug mchog la'ang mngon par 'dod med de/ /shes rab dang ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab dad pa'i rjes 'brangs la/ /'di ni sdug bsngal 'di rgyu 'di ni 'gog ces shes pas mthong phyir ro/ /nad ni shes bya nad kyi rgyu ni spang bya la/ /bde gnas thob bya sman ni bsten par bya ba ltar/ /sdug bsngal rgyu dang de 'gog pa dang de bzhin lam/ /shes bya spang bya reg par bya zhing bsten par bya/ /ji ltar tshangs pa tshangs pa yi/ /gnas nas 'phro ba med bzhin du/ /lha yi gnas ni thams cad du/ /snang ba 'bad med ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin thub pa chos sku las/ /bskyod pa med par khams kun du/ /skal ldan rnams la 'bad med par—/ /sprul pa dag ni ston par mdzad/ /ji ltar tshangs rtag gzhal yas khang na mi g.yo 'dod khams zhugs pa de/ /lha rnams kyis mthong de mthong de yang yul la dga' ba spong byed ltar/ /de bzhin bde gshegs chos kyi sku las mi bskyod 'jig rten khams kun tu/ /skal ldan gyis mthong de mthong de yang rtag tu dri ma kun sel byed/ /sngon gyi rang nyid smon lam dang / /lha rnams kyi ni dge ba'i mthus/ /ji ltar 45

tshangs pa 'bad med snang / /rang byung sprul sku de bzhin no/ /'pho dang lhums 'jug bltams dang yab kyi khab gshegs dang / /dges rol pa dang dben par spyod dang bdud bcom dang / /byang chub che brnyes zhi ba'i grong du lam ston dag /bstan nas thub pa skal med mig gi lam mi 'gyur/ /ji ltar nyi mas gdungs pa'i dus gcig tshe nyid la/ /pad sogs rgyas dang ku mu ta ni rab zum pa/ /chu skyes bye dang zum pa'i yon tan skyon dag la/ /nyi ma rtog med 'dir ni 'phags pa'i nyi de bzhin—/ /ji ltar nyi ma rtog med par/ /rang 'od cig car spros pa yis—/ /pad+ma rgyas par byed pa dang / /gzhan dag smin par byed pa ltaraglu/ /de bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /nyi ma dam chos 'od zer dag /gdul bya'i skye bo'i pad+ma la/ /rnam par rtog pa med par 'jug /chos dang gzugs kyi sku dag gis/ /byang chub snying po mkhar shar ba'i//kun mkhyen nyi ma 'gro bar ni/ /ye shes 'od zer spro bar mdzad/ /gang phyir gdul bya dag pa yi/ /chu yi snod ni thams cad la/ /bde gshegs nyi ma'i gzugs brnyan ni/ /dpag tu med pa cig car 'char—/ /rtag tu thams cad la khyab pa'i/ /chos dbyings nam mkha'i dkyil du ni/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gdul bya yi/ /ri la ji ltar 'os par 'babs/ /ji ltar rgya chen 'od zer stong ldan nyi shar 'di/ /'jig rten kun du snang bar byas nas rim gyis ni/ /mchog dang bar 46

ma dman pa'i ri la 'bab de bzhin/ /rgyal ba'i nyi ma sems can tshogs la rim gyis 'bab/ /zhing kun nam mkha'i mthil spro nyi ma la med la/ /mi shes mun bkab shes bya'i don ston pa yang min/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid sna tshogs mdog bkye'i 'od tshogs kyis/ /gsal ba dag ni 'gro la shes bya'i don ston mdzad/ /sangs rgyas grong du gshegs tshe mig dang mi ldan pa yi skye bo rnams/ /mthong zhing don med tshogs bral don de mthong ba las ni myong ba dang / /gti mug gis ldongs srid pa'i mtshor lhung lta ba'i mun pas bsgribs pa rnams/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i 'od kyis blo snang ma mthong ba yi gnas mthong 'gyur / /ji ltar yid bzhin nor bu ni/ /rtog pa med kyang cig car du / /spyod yul gnas pa rnams kyi ni/ /bsam kun so sor rdzogs byed ltaraske/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas yid bzhin la/ /brten nas bsam pa tha dad rnams/ /sna tshogs chos ni thos gyur kyang / /de ni de la rnam mi rtog /ji ltar nor bu rin chen rtog med 'dod pa'i nor/ /'bad pa med par gzhan pa dag la rab ster ltar/ /de bzhin thub pa 'bad med ji ltar 'os par ni/ /gzhan gyi don du srid pa ji srid rtag tu bzhugs / /gang phyir rgya mtsho sa 'og gnas de la 'dod pas/ /ji ltar nor bu bzang po 'gro 'dir rab rnyed dka'/ /de bzhin 'gro ba shin tu skal ngan nyon mongs zin/ /yid 'dir bde gshegs mthong ba rnyed 47

dkar shes par bya/ /ji ltar sgra brnyan gyi ni sgra/ /gzhan gyi rnam rig las byung ba/ /rnam rtog med cing bzo med la/ /phyi dang nang ni mi gnas ltar/ /de bzhinade bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung / /gzhan gyi rnam rig las byung ba/ /rnam par rtog med bzo med cing / /phyi dang nang na gnas ma yin/ /cung zad med cing snang ba med/ /dmigs pa med cing rten med la/ /mig gi lam las rab 'das pa/ /gzugs med bstan du med pa yi/ /mkha' la ji ltar mtho dang dma'/ /mthong yang de ni de lta min/ /de bzhin thams cad sangs rgyas la/ /mthong yang de ni de lta min/ /ji ltar sa las skye ba kun/ /rtog med sa la brten nas ni/ /'phel dang brten dang yangs 'gyur ltar/ /de bzhin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa/ /rnam rtog med pa la brten nas/ /'gro ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams/ /ma lus par ni 'phel bar 'gyur/ /'bad rtsol med par bya ba 'ga'/ /byed pa mthong med de bas na/ /gdul bya'i the tshom bcad pa'i phyir/ /dpe rnams dgu ni bstan pa yin—/ /gang du dpe dgu po 'di dag /rgyas par rab tu bstan gyur pa//mdo sde yi ni ming nyid kyis/ /de yi dgos pa bstan pa nyid/ /thos pa las byung shes pa yi/ /snang ba rgya chen 'dis brgyan pa'i/ /blo ldan myur du sangs rgyas kyi/ /spyod yul kun la 'jug par 'gyur/ /de don be+e ḍūr brgya byin gyi/ /gzugs brnyan la sogs de dag ni/ / rnam dgu 48

brjod pa de la ni/ /de yi bsdus don nges par bzung / /ston dang gsung dang khyab pa dang / /sprul dang ye shes spro ba dang / /thugs gsung sku yi gsang ba dang / /thugs rje'i bdag nyid thob pa nyid/ /'bad rtsol rgyun kun rab zhi ba/ /rnam par rtog pa med pa'i thugs/ /dri med be+e ḍūr brgya byin gyi/ /gzugs brnyan shar ba la sogs bzhin/ /'bad rtsol zhi ba dang bcas te/ /rtog med thugs ni gtan tshigs so//rang bzhin don ni grub don du/ /dpe ni brgya byin gzugs sogs yin / /'di ni skabs don 'di yin te/ /ston pa la sogs rnam dgu ni / /ston pa skye 'chi dang bral ba/ /'bad pa med par rab 'jug pa'oske/ /gang zhig brgya byin rnga dang sprin bzhin dang / /tshangs nyid rin chen yid bzhin nor rgyal bzhin/ /sgra brnyan nam mkha' sa bzhin srid pa'i bar/ /'bad med gzhan don mdzad de rnal 'byor rig /rin chen lha dbang snang zhing ston pa ste/ /legs par 'doms mdzad lha yi rnga dang 'dra/ /khyab bdag mkhyen dang brtse chen sprin tshogs ni/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba srid rtse'i bar du khyab/ /tshangs bzhin zag med gnas las mi bskyod par/ /sprul pa rnam pa du ma rab tu ston/ /nyi bzhin ye shes snang ba rab spro gang / /rnam dag rin chen yid bzhin nor 'dra'i thugs/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi gsung de brag ca bzhin du yi ge med—/ /sku ni nam mkha' lta bur khyab dang gzugs med rtag pa nyid/ /49

sa gzhi 'gro ba'i dkar po'i chos kyi sman rnams ma lus pa'i/ /rnam pa kun tu gzhir gyur pa ni sangs rgya sa sa yin no/ /dag pa bai ḍūr+ya 'dra yi—/ /sems la sangs rgyas mthong ba'i rgyu/ /de dag sa ni mi zlog pa'o//dad pa'i dbang po brtas pa nyid/ /dge ba skye dang 'jig pas na/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni skye dang 'jig /brgya byin bzhin du thub pa ni/ /chos kyi sku yi skye 'jig med/ /de bzhin du ni 'bad med par/ /skye med 'gag med chos sku las/ /srid pa ji srid gnas bar du/ /ston pa la sogs mdzad pa 'jug /dpe 'di rnams kyis bsdus pa yin/ /don ni 'di yin rim pa yang / /snga ma phyi ma chos mi mthun/ /spangs pa'i sgo nas brjod pa yin/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dbyangs dang mi ldan de 'dra min/ /lha yi rnga bzhin thams cad du/ /don byed min pa de 'dra min/ /sprin chen dang mtshungs don med pa'i//sa bon spong min de 'dra min/ /tshangs chen bzhin te gtan du ni/ /smin par byed min de 'dra min/ /nyi ma'i gzugs bzhin gtan du ni//mun pa 'joms min de 'dra min/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra 'byung ba ni/ /rnyed par mi dka' de 'dra min/ /sgra brnyan ba zhin te rkyen las ni/ /byung ba de dang 'dra ba'ang min/ /nam mkha' dang 'dra dag pa yi/ /gzhi min de dang 'dra ba'ang min/ /'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das pa—/ /'gro ba'i phun tshogs ma lus pa/ /de gnas pa yi rten yin phyir//50

sa yi dkyil 'khor dag dang 'dra/ /sangs rgyas byang chub la brten nas—/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i lam 'byung phyir/ /dge ba'i las lam bsam gtan dang / /tshad med pa dang gzugs med 'byung / /theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos dkon mchog gi rigs rnam par dbye ba las/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i phrin las mdzad pa'i skabs te bzhi pa'oka/ // sangs rgyas khams dang sangs rgyas byang chub dang / /sangs rgyas chos dang sangs rgyas phrin las te/ /dag pa'i sems can gyis kyang bsam bya min/ /'di ni 'dren pa rnams kyi spyod yul yin/ /blo ldan rgyal ba'i yum de la mos pa/ /sangs rgyas yon tan tshogs kyi snod 'gyur te/ /bsam med yon tan tshogs la mngon dga' bas/ /sems can kun gyi bsod nams zil gyis gnon/ /gang zhig byang chub don du gnyer bas gser zhing nor bus spras pa ni/ /sangs rgyas zhing rdul mnyam pa nyin re chos rgyal rnams la rtag 'bul na/ /gzhan gang 'di las tshig tsam thos shing thos nas kyang ni mos na 'di/ /sbyin pa las byung dge ba de las bsod nams ches mang thob par 'gyur/ /blo ldan gang zhig bla med byang chub 'dod pas bskal pa du mar yang lus ngag yid kyi 'bad pa med par tshul khrims dri med srung byed la/ /gzhan gang 'di las tshig tsam thos shing thos nas kyang ni mos na 'di/ /51

tshul khrims las byung dge ba de las bsod nams ches mang thob par 'gyur—/ /gang zhig 'di na srid pa gsum gyi nyon mongs me 'jil bsam gtan ni/ /lha dang tshangs gnas mthar son rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'pho med thabs bsgoms la/ /gzhan gang 'di las tshig tsam thos shing thos nas kyang ni mos na 'di/ /bsam gtan las byung dge ba de las bsod nams ches mang thob par 'gyur/ /gang phyir sbyin pas longs spyod dag ni sgrub byed cing / /khrims kyi mtho ris bsgoms pas nyon mongs spong byed la/ /shes rab nyon mongs shes bya kun spong de yi phyir/ /'di mchog nyid de de yi rgyu ni 'di thos yin/ /gnas dang de ni gyur pa dang / /de yi yon tan don sgrub ste/ /rgyal ba yi ni mkhyen pa'i yul/ /rnam bzhi ji skad brjod 'di la/ /blo ldan yod dang nus nyid dang / /yon tan ldan pa mos pas ni/ /myur du de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /go 'phang thob pa'i skal ldan 'gyur/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i yul 'di ni/ /yod dang bdag 'bras thob nus dang / /thob pa 'di 'dra'i yon tan dang / /ldan zhes dad pas mos pa'i phyir/ /'dun brtson dran dang bsam gtan dang / /shes rab la sogs yon tan snod/ /byang chub sems ni de dag la/ /rtag tu nye bar gnas par 'gyur/ /de ni rtag tu nyer gnas pas/ /rgyal ba'i sras po phyir mi ldog /bsod nams pha rol phyin rdzogs dang / /yongs su dag pa nyid du 'gyur/ /52

bsod nams pha rol phyin pa lnga/ /de la rnam gsum rtog med pas/ /de rdzogs yongs su dag pa ni/ /de yi mi mthun phyogs spang phyir/ /sbyin byung bsod nams sbyin pa ste/ /tshul khrims las byung tshul khrims yin—/ /bzod dang bsam gtan gnyis dag ni/ /sgom byung brtson 'grus kun tu 'gro/ /'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa gang / /de ni shes bya'i sgrib par 'dod/ /ser sna la sogs rnam rtog gang / /de ni nyon mongs sgrib par 'dod/ /shes rab las gzhan de dag ni/ /spong rgyu gzhan med de yi phyir/ /shes rab mchog yin de bzhi ni/ /thos pas de phyir thos pa mchog /de ltar yid ches lung dang rigs pa la/ /brten nas bdag nyid 'ba' zhig dag phyir dang / /gang dag mos dge phun sum tshogs ldan blo/ /de dag rjes su gzung phyir 'di bshad do/ /ji ltar sgron glog nor bu nyi zla la/ /brten nas mig dang ldan pa lta ba bzhin / /de bzhin don chen chos spobs 'od mdzad pa/ /thub la brten nas 'di nyid rab tu bshad/ /gang zhig don ldan chos dang nyer 'brel zhing / /khams gsum kun nas nyon mongs spong byed gsung / /zhi ba'i phan yon ston par mdzad pa gang / /de ni drang srong gsung yin bzlog pa gzhan/ /gang zhig rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig gi /dbang byas rnam g.yeng med yid can gyis bshad/ /thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes mthun par/ /de yang drang srong bka' bzhin spyi bos blang / /53

gang phyir rgyal las ches mkhas 'ga' yang 'jig rten 'di na yod min teske/ /ma lus de nyid mchog ni tshul bzhin kun mkhyen gyis mkhyen gzhan min pa/ /de bzhin drang srong rang nyid kyis bzhag mdo sde gang yin de mi dkrug /thub tshul bshig phyir de yang dam chos la ni gnod pa byed par 'gyur/ /nyon mongs rmongs bdag rnams kyis 'phags la skur ba dang / /des gsungs chos la brnyas gang de kun zhen ltas byas/ /des na zhen lta'i dri can de la blo mi sbyar/ /gos gtsang tshon gyis rnam 'gyur snum gyis gos pa min/ /blo dman phyir dang dkar mos bral phyir log pa'i nga rgyal la brten phyir/ /dam chos phongs pas bsgribs pa'i bdag phyir drang don de nyid nges 'dzin phyir/ /rnyed la brkam phyir lta ba'i dbang phyir chos sun 'byin pa brten pa'i phyir/ /chos 'dzin bsrings phyir mos pa dman phyir dgra bcom rnams kyi chos spong byed—/ /ji ltar zab mo'i chos rnams de bzhin mkhas pa rnams kyi me dang ni/ /mi bzad sbrul gdug gshed ma dang ni thog la'ang shin tu 'jigs mi bya/ /me sbrul dgra dang rdo rje'i me ni srog dang bral ba tsam byed de/ /de las mnar med rnams kyi 'gro ba shin tu 'jigs par 'gro mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig yang yang sdig grogs bsten pas sangs rgyas ngan sems ldan gyur dang / /pha ma dgra bcom gsod par bya ba min byed mchog tshogs 'byed pa'i mi/ /de yang chos nyid nges par bsams 54

na myur du de las thar 'gyur gyi/ /gang zhig yid ni chos la sdang ba de la thar pa ga la yod/ /dkon mchog rnam par byang khams dri med byang chub yon tan phrin las te/ /don gnas rnam bdun tshul bzhin bshad las bdag gis dge ba gang thob pa/ /des ni 'gro 'di mtha' yas 'od mnga' drang srong tshe dpag med mthong zhing / /mthong nas kyang ni chos mig dri med skyes te byang chub mchog thob shog /gang las rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir/ /ji lta bur ni gang bshad dang / /rgyu mthun pa ni gang yin te/ /tshigs su bcad pa bzhis bstan to/ /gnyis kyi bdag nyid dag pa yi/ /thabs dang gcig gis nyams pa'i rgyu/ /de nas tshigs su bcad pa ni/ /gnyis kyis 'bras bu bstan pa yin/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor bzod pa dang / /byang chub thob pa'i chos brjod pa'i/ /mdor na 'bras bu rnam gnyis ni/ /tha ma yis ni bstan pa yin/ /theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos dkon mchog gi rigs rnam par dbye ba las/ phan yon gyi skabs te lnga pa'o// //theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos mgon po byams pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //dpal grong khyer dpe med kyi mkhas pa chen po bram ze rin chen rdo rje'i dbon po paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa chen po sad dzñā na dang / lo ts+tsha ba shākya'i dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis grong khyer dpe med du bsgyur ba'o// //55
khug /theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa bzhugs so/ /rong ston shes bya kun gzigs kyis 'grel ba brtsams/

'go brjod / rgya gar skad du/ ma hā yā na ut+ta ra tan+t+ra shāstasu bhā ṣi tai/bod skad du/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab brjid shel gyi ri bo lta bu'i sku/ / legs par 'doms pa lha yi rnga sgra'i gsung / /sgrib bral rnam par dag pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog gangs ri'i mdog can rgyal/ /mkhyen pa nyi ma'i 'od zer stong 'phro zhing / /ma rig mun pa 'thibs po rnam par bsal/ /bla med chos kyi 'khor lo ston mdzad pa'i/ /thub dbang smra ba'i nyi ma la phyag 'tshal/ /sems can khams kyi dri ma rnam sbyangs nas/ /58

dri med bde gshegs go 'phang rab brnyes shing / /gzhan don phrin las ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul/ /gsal bar ston mdzad mi pham mgon la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas gsung rab legs bshad bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /blo gros chu mtshor yongs su rdzogs pa'i dpal/ /gsung rab kun gyi glegs bam gcig gyur pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam mang gsung rab phul byung zab mo'i mtsho/ /dgongs don ge sar snying po gsal ba yi/ /byams pa'i gsung rab legs bshad 'dab brgya pa/ /rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od kyis— gsal bar bya/ /theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos 'chad pa la don gsum stespyo/ bstan bcos kyi mtshan don bshad pa/ /tshig don so sor dbye ba/lo tsā ba'i 'gyur byang smos pa'o/ / rī 59

rtsa ba'i sa bcad dang po/ bstan bcos kyi mtshan don bshad pa/ dang po ni/ ma hā yā na ni theg pa chen po'o/ /ut+ta ra ni bla ma'o/ /tan+t+ra ni rgyud do/ /shāsta ni bstan bcos so/ /mtshan bshad pa ni/ /theg pa ni 'dis 'degs pas na theg pa ste 'bras bu'i theg pa'o/ /chen po ni/ dmigs pa dang ni sgrub pa dang / /ye shes brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / /thabs mkhas 'grub pa phrin las che/ /zhes pa ste/chen po bdun dang ldan pa'o/ / rgyud ni rgyun chags pa ste/ 'di'i brjod bya'i gtso bo de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni gzhi lam 'bras bu thams cad rgyun chags pa'am/ yang na rgyud dang 'dra ba ste/ khams ni rgyu rgyud dang 'dra zhing khams kyi dri ma dag par byed pa'i rkyen byang chub sogs gsum ni thabs rgyud dang 'dra la/ 'bras bu dkon mchog gsum ni 'bras bu'i rgyud dang 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ / bla ma ni gong na med pa dang khyad par du 'phags pa ste/ nges pa'i don gyi mdo'i don rtogs par dka' ba rdo rje'i gnas bdun ston pa'i phyir ro—/ / kha cig rgyud phyi ma zhes byas nas 'khor lo phyi ma nyid kyi dgongs 'grel du 'chad pa ni ma yin te/ 'dir sher phyin gyi mdo dang yang sbyar zhing / dam chos pad+ma dkar po yang mdo sde de nyid du 'khor lo 60

gnyis par yang bshad pas so/ /bltan bcos ni spyir slob ma rnams 'chos pa dang / khyad par du rgyu nyon mongs las 'chos shing / 'bras bu ngan 'gro dang srid pa las skyob pa ste/ rnam bshad rigs par/nyon mongs dgra rnams ma lus 'chos pa dang / /ngan 'gro srid las skyob byed gang yin pa/ /'chos skyob yon tan phyir na bstan bcos te//gnyis po 'di dag gzhan gyi lugs la med/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /'dir ming ni dpe dang / grangs dang / gzhung tshad dang / zhu ba po dang /yul dang / dus dang / brjod bya las btags pa sogs mang du yod pa las/ 'di ni brjod bya dang byed las las btags pa'o/ /sangs rgyas dang zhes sogs ni lo tsā bas bkod pa'o/ /bud+dha ni ma rig pa'i gnyid las sangs pa'i spangs pa la 'jug ste/ dper na gnyid sad pa lta bu'o/ /yang na shes bya la blo rgyas pa'i rtogs pa la 'jug ste/ pad+ma ma kha bye ba lta bu'o/ /de ltar don so so'i sgo nas 'chad pas rgya gar ba'i bshad pa mi 'khrul kyang bod skad du bsdoms pas bod rnams kyis ma phyed par spangs pa 'dus ma byas kyang 'ga' yis blo rgyas par smra zhing —/ gzhan dag bud+dha ma yin par smra ba sgro skur du gyur to/ /shes rab kyis byang chub dang snying rjes sems can la dmigs pas sam/byang chub kyi ched du sems pas sran thub pas byang chub sems dpa' ste/sems dpa'i sgra chags pa dang sems pa dang snying stobs la 'jug pas 61

so—/ /de thams cad la phyag 'tshal’ba ni 'dud pas so/ / rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa /tshig don so sor dbye ba/gnyis pa tshig don so sor dbye ba la gsum ste/ lus rnam par gzhag pa dang / yan lag rgyas par bshad pa/ bstan bcos brtsams pa mthar phyin pa'i don to/ / 3sa bcad dang po/ lus rnam par gzhag pa/dang po la gsum ste/ bstan bcos kyi lus rdo rje'i gnas bdun du bsdu ba/ gnas bdun mdo dang sbyar ba/ de dag 'brel bstan pa'oske dang po/ bstan bcos kyi lus rdo rje'i gnas bdun du bsdu ba/dang po ni/ sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / tshogs te dge 'dun dang —/ khams dang / byang chub dang / yon tan dang / sangs rgyas kyi phrin las ni grangs bdun gyi tha ma ste/ bdun du nges zhes pa'o/ /62

bstan bcos 'di'i dbu zhabs kun gyi lus ni phye na du ma yod kyang mdor bsdu na// brjod bya rtogs pa'i don bdun rdo rje lta bu dang /rjod byed gzhung rnams de'i gnas yin pas rdo rje'i gnas bdun po 'di dag ste/ sgra rtog gi dngos yul las 'das pas rtogs pa'i don bdun ni rdo rje lta bu ste/ rdzas kyi rdo rje de gzhan gyis phigs par dka' ba bzhin du thos bsam gyis phigs par dka' ba'i phyir ro/ /don de rnams rjod pa'i yi ge ni gnas zhes brjod de/ de thob pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i lam ston pas de'i rten du gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa/ gnas bdun mdo dang sbyar ba/gnyis pa la mdo so so nas gsungs pa'i tshul dang / mdo gcig nas gsungs pa'i tshul lo/ /gcig /mdo so so nas gsungs pa'i tshul/dang po la dkon mchog gsum ni lhag pa'i bsam pa bstan pa'i mdo las gsungs so/ /khams ni 'phel 'grib med pa'i mdo las gsungs so/ /byang chub ni dpal phreng gi mdo las gsungs so/ /yon tan ni 'phel 'grib med pa'i mdo las gsungs so/ /phrin las ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul 63

la 'jug pa bstan pa'i mdo las gsungs so/ /gnyisaske/ mdo gcig nas gsungs pa'i tshul/gnyis pa mdo gcig gis bstan tshul ni/ rdo rje'i gnas bdun po 'di rnams kyi rang gi mtshan nyid bstan pa dang bar ma chad par rjes su 'brel ba'ang 'dir bstan pa'i go rim ji lta ba bzhin du 'phags pa gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po bstan pa zhes pa'i mdor rig par bya ste/ 'di ni mdo so so nas gnas re re tsam bstan par ma zad mdo gcig las tshang ba'ang bstan ces pa'o/ /ji ltar zhe na/ mdo de'i gleng gzhi las rdo rje'i gnas gsum rig par bya ste/ ji skad du/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo legs par bskor ba/ slob ma'i tshogs shin tu dul ba mtha' yas pa mnga' ba zhes gsungs so/ /de'i lhag ma gnas bzhi ni/blo ldan byang sems dang rgyal ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi dbye ba bstan pa las rig par bya ste/ mdo der byang sems kyi rgyan bzhi/snang ba brgyad/ snying rje chen po bcu drug /phrin las so gnyis te khams yongs su dag pa'i yongs sbyong drug cu bstan pas khams gsal bar mdzad de/ sbyang bya yod na sbyong byed 'thad pa bstan cing med na 64

mi 'thad pas so/ /de'i rjes la byang chub chen po'i snying rje bcu drug bstan pas sangs rgyas kyi byang chub gsal bar mdzad do/ /de'i rjes la stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad bstan pas sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gsal bar mdzad do/ /'grel par de bstan pa'i rjes la zhes 'byung yang de logs su gsungs pa med pas stobs sogs yon tan so gnyis pos phrin las bla na med pa mdzad pas phrin las so gnyis gsal bar badzad do—/ /'dir mdo las chos kyi gtam mi 'dra ba gsum bstan pa ni/gang zag mi 'dra ba gsum gyi bde gshegs snying po sbyong bar bshad pa dang —/ byang chub sems dpa'i rigs can gyi bde gshegs snying po la dri ma rags pa dang / 'bring dang / phra ba gsum sbyong ba'i rim pa ste/dgos ched gnyis kyi dbang du byas nas chos 'khor gsum gyis dri ma sbyong tshul bstan te/ chos 'khor so so nyan pa dang / gsum char nyan pa'i dbang gis dri ma sbyong tshul gyi dbye ba gnyis gsungs so/ /gsum—/ de dag gi 'brel bstan pa/gsum pa ni don bdun po 'di rnoms kyi 'brel gang yin zhe na/'di la gnyis te/ sbyi'i don dang / tshig gi don no/ 65

(gcig) spyi'i don/ dang po ni/ thog mar sangs rgyas nas gzhan don du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs yongs su bsdu bar mdzad cing —/ dge 'dun gyis rang rgyud kyi khams sbyangs nas byang chub brnyes pas yon tan gyi tshogs dang ldan zhing / de la brten nas phrin las mdzad pa ni go rim dang po'o/ /go rim gnyis pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum thob bya'i 'bras bu/ khams dang byang chub sogs bzhi po rgyur byas pa'i rim pa'o/ /de la snga ma ni dkon mchog gsum gyis lhan cin byed rkyen byas/ rang rgyud kyi khams kyis rgyu byas nas byang chub sogs 'thob pa'i rim pa'o/ /phyi ma ni rang khams nyer len gyi rgyu dang gzhan rgyud kyi byang chub sogs kyis lhan cig byed rkyen byas pa'i rim pa gnyis bstan to/ / —(gnyis)tshig gi don/gnyis pa tshig gi don ni/ don bdun po 'di rnams kyi 'brel gang yin zhe na/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas rtogs pa'i chos thugs su chud pa las lung go chos ston pa 'byung la/ de las chos nyan pa'i dge 'dun 'byung ba'am/ chos nyams su blangs pa las byang

sems 'phags pa'i tshogs dge 'dun 'byung ba ni rgyu 'bras kyi rim pa'oske/ /tshogs las snying po ye shes ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes so/ khams ni de'i nyer len dge 'dun la yod pa ste/ lam nyams su blangs pa'i mthar dri ma thams cad kyis dag pa na snying po ye shes de thob pa ni byang chub mchog go /de las stobs sogs kyi yon tan ldan cing / yon tan de la brten nas sems can kun gyi don byed pa'i chos phrin las 'byung ba ni rgyu 'bras te go rim bzhin du 'brel ba'o/ /go rim gnyis pa'i tshig gi don ni 'og tu 'chad do/ /sa bcad gnyis pa/ yan lag rgyas par bshad pa/gnyis pa yan lag rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis te/ 'bras bu dkon mchog gsum dang / rgyu khams sogs bzhi bshad pa'o/ /dang po/ 'bras bu dkon mchog gsum bshad pa/dang po la bzhi ste/ dkon mchog gsum so so'i ngo bo/ gnas skabs gsum du dbye ba/ mthar thug gi skyabs gcig tu bsgrub pa/dkon mchog gi sgra don bshad pa'o/ / 67

gcig dkon mchog gsum so so'i ngo bo/dang po la gsum ste/(gcig)sangs rgyas dkon mchog bshad pa/sangs rgyas dkon mchog bshad pa la gsum ste/ mdo las bstan pa'i don dang / ming bshad pa dang / ming don sbyar ba'o/ / (gcigamado las bstan pa'i don/dang po ni/ sangs rgyas gang zhig yin pa de la 'dud do zhes bya'o—/ /sangs rgyas ji lta bu zhe na/ yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa ste/thog mar gsar du skye ba med pa dang / skye 'jig gnyis kyi dbus su gnas pa med pa dang / mthar 'jig pa med pa ste gsum ni rang bzhin rnam dag gi khyad par ro/ /'di ni 'dus ma byas pa'i yon tan no—/ /'dir 'dus ma byas kyi yon tan dang ldan zhes bshad pa yin gyi 'dus ma byas yin zhes brjod pa ni ma yin no/ /gal te yin na mkhyen pa dang brtse ba dang nus pa yang yin zhes brjod dgos pas 'dus ma byas su khas blangs pa dang 'gal lo/ /chos kyang 'gog lam gnyis yin zhes pa dang / dge 'dun yang rig grol gnyis yin zhes brjod 68

dgos pas 'gal ba khas blangs par 'gyur ro/ /'dir ldan pa zhes pa'i sgra'i don rtogs pa gal che'o/ /zhi ba ni glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral ba ste/ spros pa dang rnam rtog thams cad zhi bas so/ /sangs rgyas ni slob dpon med par rang byung gi ye shes kyis rnam par sangs rgyas pa ste rang don gyi yon tan no/ /sangs rgyas nas ni zhes pa ni mkhyen pa'o—/ /lam ston pa ni brtse ba'o/ /ci 'dra ba'i lam ston ce na/ phyir mi ldog pa 'jig med rtag pa'i lam mo/ /'dir spangs rtogs slar mi ldog pa la rtag pa'i sgras bstan te/ dgos pa ci'i phyir bstan ce na/gdul bya gzhan gyis yon tan dang po gsum ma rtogs pa rtogs par bya ba'i phyir du'o/ /nus pa ni mkhyen brtse'i ral gri mchog bsnams nas sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba ming gzugs kyi myu gu gcod par mdzad pa'o/ /cing ni sdud tshig go /'dir gcig pu'i sgra byas nas zla med pa la 'chad pa ni nor ba ste/ rgya dpe la gcig pu'i skad dod med pas so/ /mkhyen brtse'i rdo rje bsnams nas 'jig lta sngon du 'gro ba'i lta ba sna tshogs kyi nags 'thibs pos bskor ba'i las 'bras dang bden pa la yid gnyis za ba'i the tshom gyi rtsig pa brtan po 'jig rten pa'i shes pas rtogs shing phigs par dka' ba rnams 'jig par mdzad pa'o/ /(gnyir+sāming bshad pa/69

gnyis pa ni/ tshigs bcad 'dis ci bstan ce na/ 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub pa dang / gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs pa min pa dang ne/ mkhyen pa dang brtse ba dang nus par ldan pa ste/ don gnyis dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa nyid du brjod do—/ / (gsum)ming don sbyar ba/gsum pa ni/ mdo'i don thog ma dbus mtha' med ces pa dang /'dus ma byas zhes pa sbyar ba ni/ chos dbyings chos can/ 'dus ma byas pa'i yon tan dang ldan te/ thog mar skye ba dang / dbus su gnas pa dang / mthar 'gag pa med pa'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ye shes snang ba rgyan gyi mdor/ 'jam dpal skye ba med cing 'gag pa med pa zhes bya ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi tshig bla dwags te zhes so/ /'dus ma byas kyi sgras bstan pa la bzhi ste/ rgyu rkyen gyis skye 'gag yod med dang / las nyon gyis skye 'gag yod med dang / yid kyi lus kyis skye ba dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi bas 'gag pa yod med dang / gdul bya la skye 'gag tu snang ba yod med la 'dus ma byas su byas pa'o/ /gzhung 'dir theg chen 'phags pa kun las nyon gyis 'dus ma byas pa yin la/ 'on 70

kyang byang sems 'phags pa kun yid kyi rang bzhin gyi skye sogs kyis 'dus byas so/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni yid kyi lus kyi skye sogs kyis 'dus ma byas pa yin no/ /'on kyang gzugs sku gdul bya la skye 'gag tu snang ba yod pa'i 'dus byas so/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sku ni gdul bya la skye 'gag tu snang ba med pa'i 'dus ma byas so/ /rtogs pa'i cha ni rgyu rkyen gyis bskyed pa'i 'dus byas so/ /dbyig gnyen gyis chos sku la 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi cha gnyis bshad pa yang don de nyid do/ /'dus ma byas kyi sgra'i don du ma yod pas gzhung gi skabs gang du tshul gang gi dbang du byas pa'i 'dus ma byas so sor phye ste bshad dgos so/ /skabs 'dir ni gdul bya la skye 'gag tu snang ba med pa'i 'dus ma byas te ji skad du/ brgya byin bzhin du thub pa ni/ /chos kyi sku yi skye 'jig med/ /ces so/ /'di ni khyad par bzhi ldan te/ zab pa'i khyad par ni 'dus ma byas pa'o/ /bde ba'i khyad par ni yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus dang de'i rgyu bag chags log pa'o/ /bral ba'i khyad par ni sgrib gnyis zhi ba'o/ /rtag pa'i khyad par ni sgra rtog gi yul ma yin pa'o/ /mdo'i don zhi ba zhes pa dang lhun grub ces pa'i ming sbyar ba ni/ zhi ba ni chos dbyings sgrib gnyis kyis dag pa chos can/ lhun gyis grub pa zhes brjod de/ sgrib gnyis spangs pa'i ye shes kyi chos sku yin pa'i phyir/ mdo las bstan 71

pa'i don sangs rgyas nyid rang rnam sangs rgyas zhes pa dang / gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa zhes pa'i ming sbyar ba ni/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos sku chos can/ gzhan gyi sgra dang rtags sogs kyi rkyen gyis rtogs bya min te/ rang byung gi ye shes kyis so so rang gis rig par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ mdo'i don dang mkhyen pa zhes pa'i ming sbyar ba ni/sangs rgyas chos can/ mkhyen pa dang ldan te/ ji skad bstan pa'i don gsum po gzhan las ma thos par rang nyid kyis brjod du med pa'i don rtogs pa'i phyir/ mdo'i don dang brtse ba zhes pa'i ming sbyar ba ni—/ thugs brtse ba chen po dang ldan te/ don gsum po de ma rtogs pa rnams la de rtogs pa'i don du lam ston pa'i phyir/ mdo'i don dang nus pa zhes pa'i ming sbyar ba ni/ nus pa dang ldan te/ ye shes kyis gzhan gyi sdug bsngal spong / thugs rje yis nyon mongs spong ba'i phyir/yon tan drug po ye shes snang ba rgyan gyi mdo dang sbyar ro/ /drug po de rnams las dang po gsum gyis rang don bstan/ phyi ma gsum gyis gzhan don bstan to/ / (gnyis)chos dkon mchog bshad pa/gnyis palhas dkon mchog la yang gsum ste/ mdo'i don bstan pa dang / ming bshad pa/ ming don sbyar ba'o/ /72

(gcig)mdo'i don bstan pa/dang po la 'gog lam gnyis las/ 'gog bden ni/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i yon tan dang ldan te/ de kho nar yod pa dang /med pa dang / yod med gnyis ka dang / gnyis ka las gzhan pa'i mu bzhi gang du'ang rtog ge'i blos brtag par mi nus pas rtog pa'i dngos yul min pa dang / sgra bshad pa dang 'jug pa'i nges tshig dang bral ba yin te/ sgra'i dngos yul min pas so/ /theg chen 'phags pa'i ye shes kyis so so rang gis rig par bya ba ste/ gsum po ni rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos so/ /sgrib gnyis zhi ba ni glo bur rnam dag go/ /lam bden ni nyi ma dang chos mtshungs te/ ngo bo dri ma med pa dang / ye shes kyi 'od zer gyis shes bya thams cad snang bar byed pa dang ldan pa dang ske/ dmigs pa dang gzugs sogs yid du 'ong ba dang / mi 'ong ba dang / bar ma kun la rim pa bzhin du chags pa dang / sdang ba dang ske/ gti mug gi rab rib rnam par 'joms par mdzad pa'o/ /de ltar na 'gog lam gyi dam pa'i chos gnyis po de la 'dud do/ /zhes sbyar ro/ /(gnyis)ming ba shad pa/73

gnyis pa ni/ 'dis ci bstan ce na/ bsam du med pa'i yon tan dang / las nyon dang rnam rtog gnyis med pa'i yon tan dang /rtog pa med pa dang / dag pa dang / gsal ba dang / gnyen po'i phyogs nyid kyis na yon tan drug bstan to/ /ngo bo gang zhig chags pa dang bral ba dang / gang gis chags pa dang bral bar byed pa rnam byang gi bden pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid can te chos dkon mchog yin la/chags bral nyid ni 'dod chags dang bral ba'i 'gog bden dang /lam bden gyis bsdus te/ gnyis po kho na'i gnas skabs la 'dir chags bral zhes 'jog pas so/ /(gsum)ming don sbyar ba/gsum pa ni/ 'gog lam de dag kyang go rim bzhin du bsam du med pa sogs kyi yon tan gsum dang / dag pa sogs gsum gyi yon tan gyis rab tu phye bar rig par bya'o/ /ji ltar rig par bya zhe na/'gog bden ni bsam du med pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa nyid yin te/yod med sogs mu bzhir rtog ge'i blos brtag bya min pa'i don dang ldan pa'i phyir dang / sgras brjod bya min pa'i phyir dang / 'phags pa'i ye shes kyis so sor mkhyen bya yin pa'i phyir/ yang mdo las gsungs pa'i zhi ba'i don dang ming sbyar ba ni/ 'gog bden chos can/ las 74

nyon gnyis med pa ste nyon sgrib spangs pa dang / de'i rgyu tshul min yid byed kyi rtog pa med pas shes sgrib spangs pa ste/ spangs pa'i yon tan gnyis dang ldan te sgrib gnyis zhi ba'i phyir/ de yang sgrib pa ngo bo nyid kyi yod pa 'gags pa'i dngos smra bas 'dod pa'i 'gog bden lta bu min par sgrib pa ngo bo nyid kyis med pa mngon du gyur par ye shes snang ba rgyan dang dpal phreng gi mdo las bshad do/ /'dis ni sems tsam du 'chad pa bkag pa yin no/ /dag sogs gsum gyi don dang ming sbyar ba ni/ dag sogs gsum ni nyi bzhin no/ /zhes pas bstan te/lam bden ni nyi ma dang mtshungs te/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnam par dag cing gzugs gsal bar byed pa dang mun pa'i gnyen por gyur pa ltaraske/ ngo bo dri mas dag cing gsal bar byed pa dang / de kho na nyid mthong ba'i gegs sgrib pa'i gnyen por gyur pa'i phyir/ lam 'di yum gyi mdo dang sbyar bas gzhung 'di bka' phyi ma kho na'i dgongs 'grel du 'dod pa mi 'thad do/ /(gsum)dge 'dun dkon mchog bshad pa/gsum pa dge 'dun dkon mchog la'ang gsum ste/ mdo las bstan pa'i don dang / ming bshad pa dang / ming don sbyar ba'o/ /75

(gcig)mdo las bstan pa'i don / dang po la ji lta ba rig pa dang / ji snyed pa rig pa dang / so so rang gis rig pa ste gsum dang / chags pa'i sgrib pa dang / thogs pa'i sgrib pa dang / dman pa'i sgrib pa las grol ba gsum dang / rig grol gnyis so sor byas pas yon tan brgyad dang ldan no/ /de la ji lta ba rig pa ni/ yang dag rtogs nas zhes sbyar ro/ /gang gis rtogs she na / byang sems 'phags pa gang dag gis so/ /yul ci zhig rtogs she na / 'gro ba kun gyi bdag med gnyis te/ chos dang gang zag gi dbye bas so/ /bdag med gnyis po yang chos thams cad snying po de'i mthar thug pas mtha' zhes pa spros pa thams cad zhi ba'o/ /rgyu gang gis rtogs she na/ sems la yod pa'i nyon mongs pa rnams gdod ma nas ngo bo nyid med par gzigs pas so/ /ji ltar na sems la nyon mongs pa ngo bo nyid kyis med ce na/ sems de rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bas so/ /'di la rnam par dag pa'i yul can zhes brjod do/ /ji snyed pa rig pa ni/ sems can thams cad la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi snying po rjes su zhugs par gzigs pa'i blo'o/ /'di ni mtha' yas pa'i yul can no/ /so so rang gis rig pa shugs kyis bstan to/ /grol ba'i yon tan ni sgrib pa med pa zhes pas bstan to/ /mnga' ba zhes pas yon tan de dag byang sems kyi rgyud la yod par bstan to/ /76

tshul de lta bu'i rig grol gnyis mnga' ba'i byang sems 'phags pa de la 'dud do/ /(gnyis)ming bshad pa/gnyis pa ni/ tshigs su bcad pa 'dis ci bstan ce na/ blo ldan byang sems 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs ni rig pa gsum dang ldan te/ ji bzhin gzigs pa dang / ji snyed gzigs pa dang / nang gi ye shes kyi gzigs pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/ grol ba gsum dang ldan te—/ chags pa'i sgrib pa dang thogs pa'i sgrib pa gnyis dag pa'i phyir dang —/ bla na med pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa nyid kyi phyir/ rig pa gsum ni ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa rig pa'i rgyu las yin zhing / ji lta ji snyed rig pa de nyid rang gis nyams su myong ba'i rgyu las yin la/ sgrib pa gsum las grol ba ni/ rig pa gnyis po de dang bla na med pa'i yon tan brnyes pa las yin no/ /(gsum)ming don sbyar ba/ gsum pa ni/ byang sems 'phags pa chos can/ ji lta ba rtogs pa dang ldan te/ 'gro ba thams cad bdag gnyis gdod ma nas nye bar zhi ba'i chos nyid du rtogs pa'i phyir/ ci'i phyir de ltar rtogs she 77

na—/ nyon mongs pa rnams gdod ma nas ngo bo nyid kyis zad par mthong ba'i phyir te/ sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bar gzigs pa'i phyir/ 'dir 'gro ba'i sgras ni chos dang gang zag gnyis ka bzung ngo —/ /ji snyed pa yod par gzigs pa dang ldan pa yin te/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos nyid dang rang bzhin rnam dag gi cha sems can thams cad la yod par gzigs pa'i phyir/ blo gang gis rtogs she na/shes bya'i mthar thug chos kyi dbyings rtogs pa'i blos so/ /'di sa dang po nas 'thob ste/ chos kyi dbyings kun tu 'gro ba'i don rtogs pas so/ /'dir mnyam gzhag tu ji lta ba dang / rjes thob tu ji snyed pa rig pa yin no/ /de ltar byang sems 'phags pas ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa rtogs pa de ni gzhan dang thun mong min pa 'phags pa'i so so rang gis rig pa'i ye shes kyis mthong ba nyid yin no/ /de yang ji lta ba rig pas dri ma med pa'i dwabyings sems can gyi khams rang bzhin rnam dag rtogs pas chags pa med pa dang / ji snyed pa rig pas shes bya mtha' yas pa rtogs pas thogs pa med pa'i phyir te/ nyan rang gi ye shes kyi mthong ba la ltos —nas dag pa yin no/ /'dis ni nang rig pa dang chags thogs kyi sgrib pa las grol bar bshad do/ /ji lta ji snyed nang gi ni ye shes kyi gzigs pa dang chags thogs kyi sgrib pa dag pas na sangs rgyas kyi ye shes bla na med pa dang nye ba'i phyir ram/ rig grol 78

gang dang ldan pas sems can thams cad kyi skyabs su 'gyur ba de las gzhan tshul khrims sogs byang sems kyi yon tan rnams khyad par du 'phags pas bla na med pa ste/— de'i phyir byang sems 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa rnams ni lus can kun gyi skyabs yin no/ /dkon mchog gsum car rig grol la brjod na khyad par ci yod ce na/ theg chen mi slob pa'i rig grol sangs rgyas dang / slob pa'i rig grol ldan pas dge 'dun dang / ldan chos chos dkon mchog go / —gnyisaske/ gnas skabs skyabs gsum du dbye ba/gnyis pa gnas skabs skyabs gsum du dbye ba la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang / tshig gi don to/ / (gcig)spyi'i don/dang po la dri ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo sder thun mong gi skyabs gsum rnam par gzhag pa gang zag gang gi dbang du byas she na zhes pa ste/ 'di ni lung dang theg dman skyabs su ma bzhag pa la dri ba'o—/ /lan bstan pa ni/ rang nyid 'jigs pa las thar ba'i phyir du don du gnyer bar bya ba'i dbang du byas nas skyabs gsum ste/ theg pa chen po'i lam du zhugs pa dag ni rang nyid 'jigs pa las thar 79

bar bya ba'i phyir rdu sangs rgyaso kyi dngos po don du gnyer bas sangs rgyas skyabs su bzhagoci nga / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la zhugs pa rnams ni rang nyid 'jigs pa las thar bar bya ba'i phyir du rten 'brel zab mo'i chos rtogs pa don du gnyer bas chos dkon mchog skyabs su bzhag la/ nyan thos kyi thege pa la zhugs pa rnams ni rang nyid 'jigs pa las thar bar bya ba'i phyir du dge 'dun gyi dngos po don du gnyer bas dge 'dun dkon mchog skyabs su bzhag go /gal te gang zag gcig kyang dkon mchog gsum ka la skyabs su 'gro ba min namaske/ ci'i phyir gang zag so so la skyabaso re re rnam par bzhag ce na/rgyu'i skyabs gnas kyi dbang du byas pa ste/ gang zag gcig kyang gsum ka la skyabs su 'dzin pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu'i skyabs gnas kyi dbang du byas na rang rang gi don du gnyer bya'i 'bras bu thob pa na 'jigs pa las thar ba'i dbang du byas te/ so so'i thob bya skyabs su bzhag pa yin no/ /gal te 'bras bu thob zin na de la skyabs su 'dzin mi dgos la—/ ma thob na skyabs su ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ lam du zhugs pa'i dus su ni thob bya skyabs su 'dzin pa yin la/ 'bras bu thob na skyabs su gyur pa yin zhes brjod do/ /dkon mchog gsum la bya ba byed par mos pa na gzhan rgyud la grub zin gyi dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'dzin pa ste/ snga ma la nges legs don du gnyer ba'i gang zag gsum 80

dang —/ phyi ma la mngon mtho don du gnyer ba'i gang zag gsum du brjod do/ /ldog pas rnam par phye ba yin gyi gang zag rdzas tha dad pa drug ni ma yin te/ dper na sangs rgyas kyi dngos po don du gnyer ba'i ldog pa nas nges legs don du gnyer ba dang / de thob pa'i ched du sangs rgyas la bya ba byed par mos pa'i ldog pa nas mngon mtho don du gnyer ba zhes brjod do/ /lhag ma gnyis la yang tshul de bzhin no/ /skabs 'di'i sangs rgyas ni rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog ces pas gzugs sku la brjod do/ /(gnyis)tshig gi don/gnyis pa tshig don ni/ byang sems kyi theg pa ba'i gang zag sangs rgyas kyi dngos po don du gnyer ba la zhugs pa dang / de'i ched du sangs rgyas la bya ba byed par mos pa rnams la ston pa sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bstan pa'i don gyis sangs rgyas dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i gang zag rten 'brel zab mo'i chos rtogs pa don du gnyer ba dang —/ de'i ched du chos la bya ba byed par mos pa rnams la bstan pa dam pa'i chos kyi yon tan bstan pa'i don gyis chos dang / nyan thos kyi theg pa'i gang zag dge 'dun gyi dngos po don du gnyer ba dang /de'i ched du dge 'dun la bya ba byed par mos pa rnams la dge 'dun 81

gyi yon tan bstan pa'i don gyis dge 'dun skyabs su bzhag go /theg pa thun mong gi skyabs gsum rnam par gzhag pa 'di ni sems can rnams theg pa gsum la rim gyis gzhug pa'i don no/ /gsum pa ni/thun mong gi skyabs gsum du rnam par bzhag pa de las chos dang dge 'dun gnyis ni mthar thug gam gtan du ba'i skyabs ma yin te/ 'di ltar chos la gnyis las/ mdo sde la sogs pa ni lam rgyud la skyes pa na chu brgal zin pa'i gzings ltar spang bya yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir skyabs gsum gyi zlar bgrang ba'i chos dkon mchog ni slob pa'i chos yin pas rtogs pa'i chos la lam ni gtan du ba'am brtan pa'i skyabs ma yin te/bslu ba'i chos can yin pa'i phyir te/ rtogs pa gong nas gong du 'pho ba'i 'dus byas 'gyur ba'i chos can yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba shes rab lasaske/ 'du byed thams cad slu ba'i chos/ /des na de dag brdzun pa yinaske/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /slu ba'i don ni rigs pa drug cu pa'i 'grel par7/ 'dus byas ni tha snyad pa'i blo la snang zhing snang ba ltar 'gyur zhing mi gnas pa'i phyir zhes bshad do/ /yang mthar thug gi skyabs ma yin te/ mthar thug gi yon tan dang mi ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /rtag mi rtag gi tha snyad la yang skad cig gis 'jig mi 'jig dang / rgyu 'gag mi 'gag dang / slar/ ldog mi ldog rnams la bshad de/ skabs gang du yod pa'i tshul brtags nas khas blang bar bya'o/ /'gog bden yang 82

mthar thug gi skyabs min par 'og nas ston to/ /dge 'dun dkon mchog kyang mthar thug gi skyabs min te/ 'chi 'pho'i 'jigs pa dang bcas pa'i phyir/ byang sems 'phags pa la yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho yod na gzhan rnams la lta ci smos/ 'dir sangs rgyas kyi 'gog pa ni sangs rgyas su 'dus shing / byang sems kyi 'gog pa ni mthar thug gi yon tan dang mi ldan la/ nyan rang gi lhag bcas kyi dus su sdug bsngal dang ma bral bas mthar thug gam gtan du ba'i skyabs su mi 'os so/ /gal te lhag med kyi myang 'das ni sdug bsngal dang bral bas mthar thug gi skyabs so snyam na min te/ mar me shi ba ltar las nyon dang sdug bsngal med pa tsam gyis rab tu phye la/ med pa dgag pa tsam ni skyabs su 'os pa min te/ ri bong gi rwa bzhin no/ /yang na don 'di yin te/ byang sems kyi 'gog bden ni mthar thug gi skyabs min te/ byang sems kyi 'gog pa thob kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho dang ma bral ba'i phyir/ nyan thos kyi lhag bcas kyi myang 'das kyang mthar thug gi skyabs min te/ de thob kyang sdug bsngal dang ma bral ba'i phyir/ gal te lhag med kyi myang 'das mthar thug gi skyabs so snyam na min te/ mthar thug gi yon tan med par sdug bsngal med pa tsam gyis rab tu phye ba'i phyir/ gang med pa dgag tsam ni mthar thug gi skyabs su 'os pa min te/ ri bong gi rwa bzhin no/ /83

zhes 'chad na legs so/ /gangs ri'i khrod kyi mkhas rlom kun/ /ma lus gcig tu 'dus pa'i blos/ /ring du brtags kyang ma rtogs pa/ /gzhan las lhag pa'i blo yis rtogs/ /theg pa gsum gyi dge 'dun gyi tshogs kyang gtan du ba'i skyabs ma yin te/ rang nyid 'jigs pa dang bcas pa'i phyir te/ byang sems 'phags pa dang nyan rang mi slob pa rnams bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho dang bcas/ gzhan nyan rang slob pa rnams las nyon gyi dbang gis 'chi 'pho dang bcas pa'i phyir/gsumaglu/ mthar thug skyabs gcig tu bsgrub pa/ —gsum pa mthar thug gi skyabs gcig tu bsgrub pa ni/ dam pa'i don te nges pa'i don du na 'gro ba'i skyabs mthar thug pa ni sangs rgyas nyan gcig yin te/ thub pa ni rnam par byang ba mthar thug pa'i chos kyi sku can yin pa'i phyir dang / tshogs dge 'dun dkon mchog rnams kyang de thob na yon tan mthar thug pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi—/ dkon mchog gi sgra don bshad pa/bzhi pa dkon mchog gi sgra don ni/ ci'i phyir skyabs gsum po de la dkon mchog ces brjod ce na/ chos mthun pa drug gis nor bu dang 'dra bar brjod de/ ji ltar nor bu rnyed dka' ba dang / dri ma 84

med pa dang / dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i mthu dang ldan pa dang / mdzes pas rgyan du gyur pa dang / rin po che bcos ma las mchog tu gyur pa dang —/ bstod smad sogs kyis mi 'gyur ba de ltar skyabs gsum po 'di yang dge rtsa ma bskrun pa rnams dang bskal pa mang por yang mi 'phrad pas 'byung ba dkon pa'i phyir dang / sgrib gnyis kyi dri ma med pa'i phyir dang / mngon shes sogs yon tan gyi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i phyir dang / 'jig rten pa'i bsam pa dge ba thams cad kyi rgyu yin pas rgyan du gyur pa'i phyir dang / 'jig rten las 'das pas 'jig rten las mchog nyid kyi phyir dang / las nyon sogs kyis 'dus ma byas pas 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir dkon mchog nyid do// //gnyis pa/ rgyu khams sogs bzhi bshad pa/gnyis pa rgyu khams sogs bzhi bshad pa la gsum ste/ thun mong du bstan pa dang / so sor bshad pa/ de la mos pa'i phan yon no/ /gcig thun mong du bstan pa/dang po la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa'o—/ / 85

(gcig)mdor brastan pa/ dang po ni/ dri bcas de bzhin nyid ni nyon mongs pa'i sbubs las ma— grol ba'i khams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po zhes brjod pa ste / dri bcas kyi sems kyi stong nyid do/ /des na dpal phreng dang 'grel par yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po nyon mongs pa'i sbubs las ma grol ba'i khams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos sku ni sbubs las grol bar bshad do/ /de yang phyi ma ni de ltar nges la/ snga ma ni gtso che ba'i dbang du byas pa ste/ snying po ni 'bras bu'i gnas skabs na yang yod par bshad pas so/ /'dis ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po mtshan nyid pa dag pa gnyis ldan gyi sangs rgyas kho nar 'dod pa'ang bkag ste/ snying po'i gtso bo dri bcas de bzhin nyid du lan gcig ma yin par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /dri med de bzhin nyid ni de bzhin nyid dri ma thams cad kyis dag pa sangs rgyas kyi sar gnas yongs su gyur pa'i mtshan nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos sku zhes brjod do/ /dri ma med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ni gnas gyur pa'i mtshan nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku de nyid la yod pa 'jig rten las 'das pa stobs bcu sogs sangs rgyas kyi chos gang dag yin pa'o/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa ni stobs bcu sogs sangs rgyas kyi chos de dag nyid kyi so so rang gi bla na med pa'i phrin las so/ /rgyu rkyen gnas bzhi po 86

gang las 'bras bu dkon mchog dge ba gsum 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen gnas bzhi po 'di ni don dam gzigs pa sangs rgyas rnams kyi yul nyid yin gyi nyan rang sogs kyis bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /—(gnyis)rgyas par bshad pa/gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis te/ bsam gyis mi khyab par bsgrub pa dang / khams sogs bzhi po rgyu rkyen du 'gyur tshul lo/ /(gcig)bsam gyis mi khyab par bsgrub pa/dang po ni/ 'bras bu dkon mchog gsum po 'di'i rigs te rgyu ni thams cad gzigs pa sangs rgyas rnams kyi yul yin la/ rigs de yang khams sogs rnam pa bzhi ste/ go rim bzhin du rkyen bzhi yis bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /rgyu mtshan bzhi 'god pa ni/ dri bcas de bzhin nyid ni nyan rang rnams kyis bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par+ha dag pa'ang yin la nyon mongs pa dang ldan pa'ang yin pas 'gal ba ltar snang ba'i phyir/ don la mi 'gal te/ dag pa ni khams dri ma'i rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i rang sazhin rnam dag yin la/ma dag pa ni glo bur gyi dri ma dang ldan pa'o/ /dri med de bzhin nyid ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ gdod ma nas dag bya kun nas nyon mongs pa ngo 87

bo nyid kyis med pa dang / phyis dri ma gnyen pos gsar du dag pa 'gal ba ltar snang ba'i phyir ro/ /don la mi 'gal te/ sngar med pa ni dri ma khams kyi rang bzhin du med pa yin la/ phyis dag pa ni gser la g.ya' dag pa'i tshul gyi dbang du byas so/ /sdi ma med pa'i yon tan yang bsam gyis mi khyab —ste/ so so'i skye bo'i gnas skabs na med na'ang phyis dri mas rnam par dag pa chos nyid la rnam par dbye ba med pa'i tshul gyis ldan pa'i phyir/ don la mi 'gal te/ so skye'i gnas skabs su dri mas ma dag pas yon tan med kyang phyis dri mas dag pa na chos nyid la yon tan 'bral mi rung gi tshul du yod pa'i phyir/ dper na gser g.ya' ma dag pa'i skabs su 'od med kyang phyis 'od dbyer med du 'jug pa bzhin no/ /des na gzhi 'bras kun tu rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos nyid la rigs mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba med kyang gcig tu 'dod pa ni ma yin te/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ rten pa'i chos kyi bye brag gis/ /de yi dbye ba yongs su brjod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gal te dag ma dag gi chos nyid gcig yin na/ dri bcas de bzhin nyid dang dri med de bzhin nyid kyi khyad par gang gig 'byed/ ngo bo gcig yin yang chos can dri mas dag ma dag gis 'byed do zhe na/ chos nyid kyang chos can rang rang gi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa la 'dod pas ji ltar gcig yin/ galha te stong gsum dar yug chen po'i dpes

sems can kun la yon tan tshang bar gsungs pas na gzhi dus dang yon tan yod do zhe na/ mdo de las chos kyi dbyings sems can gyi gnas thams cad la rnam par gzigs nas zhes gsungs pa dang /chos nyid snga phyi khyad par med pa'i phyir zhes gsungs paso na/ yon tan gyi chos nyid rang bzhin rnam dag gi cha dang khyad par med pa'i chos nyid yod pa la dgongs so/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa yang bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ 'bad pa la mi ltos par lhun gyis grub cing 'di ltar bya'o zhes rtog pa med bzhin du sems can gyi don mdzad pas 'gal ba ltar snang ba'i phyir/ don la mi 'gal ba'i tshul ni 'og tu phrin las ston pa'i dpe dgus ston no/ /(gnyis) khams sogs bzhi po rgyu rkyen du 'gyur tshul/gnyis pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum thob par byed pa'i rgyu ni gnas bzhi po 'dis bstan pas na bzhi po 'dir nges te/ 'di ltar khams ni rtogs bya'i gnas te/ khams rtogs na grol bar 'gyur la/ ma rtogs na mi grol bas so/ /byang chub ni rtogs pa'i gnas te/ khams dri ma kun gyis dag pa rtogs pa'i ngo bo yin pas so/ /byang chub de'i yan lag ni yon tan te/ byang chub la brten pa'i yon tan yinapa'i phyiraske/ phrin las ni rtogs par byed pa'i gnas yin te/ yon tan de 89

rnams nyid kyis phrin las kyi sgo nas gzhan la rtogs pa sgrub par byed pas so/ /de'ang go rim bzhin du gnas gcig khams de ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi sa bon yin pas so so rang gi tshul bzhin yid la byas pas dri mas rnam par dag pa la brten nas dkon mchog gsum 'byung bas rgyu'o/ /byang chub sogs gsum ni mngon par byang chub pa na stobs sogs yon tan dang ldan zhing de la brten nas chos ston pa'i phrin las mdzad pa na dkon mchog gsum 'byung bas rkyen no—/ /ci ste khams stong pa nyid ni bya byed dang bral ba'i phyir/ sa bon dang rgyur mi 'thad ce na/ gang la stong pa nyid rung ba/ /de la thams cad rung ba yin/ /zhes dbu ma rtsa ba dang rtsod pa bzlog par gsungs pa ltar te/ don de nyid rgyal ba'i yum du'ang / rab 'byor gzugs dngos po yin te dngos po med par ma gyur na theg pa chen po 'dis kyang lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten zil gyis mnan nas nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs soske gnyisarka/ so sor bshad pa/gnyis pa so sor bshad pa la bzhi ste/ khams dang / byang chub dang ske/ yon tan dang / phrin las rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /90

(gcig)khams rgyas par bshad pa/dang po la don lnga ste/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi snying po can du bstan pa dang / khams rnam gzhag bcu yis gtan la dbab pa dang / snying po dri mas bsgribs tshul bstan pa dang / gang zag gang gis rtogs pa bstan pa dang / khams bstan pa'i dgos pa'o//(gcig)sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi snying po can du bstan pa/dang po ni/ dri bcas de bzhin nyid kyi dbang du mdzad nas mdo sde du mar sems can thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can no zhes gsungs pa'i don gang yin zhe na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos sku 'phro ba'i phyir dang / chos sku'i de bzhin nyid rang bzhin rnam dag gi cha dang dbyer med pa'i de bzhin nyid ldan pa'i phyir dang /chos sku'i rigs te khams kyi nus pa yod pa'i phyir na don gsum gyis lus can kun rtag tu sangs rgyas kyi snying po can zhes gsungs so/ /ma hās gsum po rim pa ltar 'bras bu dang rang bzhin dang rgyu'i bde gshegs snying po ste/ dang po chos sku ni de bzhin gshegs pa dngos 91

yin la/ sems can gyi snying po ni btags pa ba yin zhing / sems can rnams kyis thob tu rung ba'i phyir khyab par bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang sems can gnyis ka'i snying po dngos teglu/ de bzhin nyid rang bzhin rnam dag tsam gyi ldog pa nas gnyis ka la dngos su yod pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa de'i rgyu yin pas der btags la/ sems can gyi snying po ni dngos so zhes 'chad do/ /'di'i 'grel par yang / sems can phung po'i nang na sangs rgyas ye shes gnas/ /de ni rang bzhin gnyis med dri ma med/ /sangs rgyas rigs la 'bras bur btags nas ni/ /lus can thams cad sangs rgyas snying por brjod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang na 'grel par gsum po 'di snying po'i mdo'i rjes su 'brangs te 'og nas ston par 'gyur ro zhes bshad pas 'og nas/ 'di yi rang bzhin chos sku dang / /de bzhin nyid dang rigs kyang ste/ /de ni dpe gsum gcig dang ni/ /lnga rnams kyis ni shes par bya/ /zhes snying po'i dpe dgu dang sbyar te/ 'grel par rgyas bshad du/ rtogs pa chos skus sems can kun la khyab pa ni/ sems can thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku 'phro ba'i don te/ de'i don yang 'grel par sangs rgyas kyi gzugs dang sprang rtsi dang snying po'i dpe 'di gsum gyis ni chos kyi skus lus pa med pa'i sems can gyi khams la khyab pa'i don gyi 92

dbang du byas nas/ sems can 'di dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can yin no zhes bstan to/ /zhes dang / mdo sde rgyan shes byed du drangs pa ni/ ji ltar nam mkha' rtag tu kun song 'dod/ /de bzhin 'di ni rtag tu kun song 'dod/ /ji ltar nam mkha' gzugs rnams kun tu song / /de bzhin 'di yang sems can tshogs kun song / /zhes so—/ /'di dag gi don ni rtogs pa chos sku dang / bstan pa chos sku gnyis kyi gnas gyur thob pa'i rgyu rang bzhin rnam dag gi cha yis sems can kun la khyab pa'i don no/ /de bzhin nyid dang dbyer med pa'i don ni/ 'di ni bden pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis stong pas gzhi 'bras kun dang phyi nang kun la khyab pas dbyer med pa zhes bshad la/ rigs kyis khyab pa ni rkyen gyis sad par bya ba'i sems kyi nus pa sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi nyer len gyi rgyu'o/ /ji skad du/ lus can la yod zag pa med pa'i shes pa sbrang ma'i rtsi dang 'dra/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sbyang bar bya ba'i khams bshad pa dang / rigs kyi las sdug bde'i skyon yon mthong bar bshad pa'ang 'di nyid kyi las so/ /'dir chos sku 'phro ba'i don phrin las kyis khyab pa la 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ mdo sde rgyan gyi lung shes byed du drangs pa'i don dang 'gal ba sa so/ /des na rang bzhin rnam dag ni sems rgyud kyis bsdus pa kho na'i dbang du byas la/de bzhin nyid ni phyi nang kun la khyab pa'i phyir/ zlos pa'i skyon las 93

grol lo/ /de bzhin nyid dang rang bzhin rnam dag ni yon tan dang yon tan can gyi tshul du yod de/ gzhung 'dir yang / yon tan rang bzhin dag pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi de bzhin nyid sems can kun la dbyer med par yod pa ni sems can thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i de bzhin nyid dbyer med pa'i don te/ 'grel par gser gyi dpe gcig gis ni de bzhin nyid dbyer med pa'i don gyi dbang du byas nas de ba zhin gshegs pa'i de bzhin nyid sems can 'di dag gi yin no zhes —dang / shes byed drangs pa ni/ de bzhin nyid ni thams cad la/ khyad rbar med kyang dag gyur pas/ /de bzhin gshegs nyid de yi phyir/ /'gro kun de yi snying po can/ /zhes te chos nyid ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa la khyad par med bas so/ /sangs rgyas kyi sku rnam pa gsum bskyedari pa'i rigs sems can la yod pa ni sems can thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs yod pa'i don te/ 'grel par gter dang ljon shing dang rin po che'i sku dang 'khor los —sgyur ba dang gser gyi gzugs te/ dpe lhag ma lnga po 'di da—ga gis ni sangs rgyas kyi sku rnam pa gsu ma bskyed pa'i rigs yod pa'i dbang du byas nase/de bzhin gshegs po 'i khams 'di dgasems cane thams cad kyi snying por bstan pa yin no zhes dang /rkashes byed durtechotshos matren pa'i mdor/thog mad+dhad pe'i dus can khalas/ /chos rnams kun gyi gnas yin te/ /94

de yod pas na 'gro ba kun/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pa drangs so/ /bstan bshad gnyis kas rgyu don gsum gyi snying po can du bshad de/ shin tu 'a grig cing 'di nyid dgongs par gdon mi za'oske/ /(gnyis) khams rnam gzhag bcu yis gtan la dbab pa/gnyis pa la gsum ste/ sdom tshig gis mdor bstan pa dang /rgyas par bshad pa dang / mjug bsdu ba'o/ / 〈gcig〉sdom tshig gis mdor bstan pa/dang po ni/ ngo bo rgyu 'bras las ldan 'jug pa dang / /gnas skabs de bzhin kun tu 'gro ba'i don/ /rtag tu mi 'gyur yon tan dbyer med ni/ /don dam dbyings kyi dgongs don yin zhes bya/ /zhes te/ phyi ma lnga gcig las gcig 'phros pa'o/ / 〈gnyis〉rgyas par bshad pa/gnyis pa la brgyad de/ ngo bo dang rgyu'i don/ 'bras bu dang las kyi don/ ldan pa'i don/ 'jug pa'i don/ gnas skabs kyi don/kun tu 'gro ba'i don/ mi 'gyur ba'i don/ — yon tan dbyer med 95

pa'i don no/ / 〈gcig〉 ngo bo dang rgyu'i don/dang po la gnyis te/ thun mong du bstan pa dang / so sor bshad pa'o / /(gcig)thun mong du bstan pa/dang po la ngo bo ni/ don gsum gyi ngo bo la rang spyi gnyis las/chos sku dang de bzhin nyid dang rigs kyi rang mtshan ni rin chen dang nam mkha' dang chu bzhin dang / spyi mtshan ni dpe gsum ka rang bzhin gyis dag pa bzhin du rtag tu rang bzhin gyis nyon mongs pa med pa'o/ /rgyu ni theg chen gyi chos la mos pa dang / lhag pa'i shes rab dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snying rje chen po las byung ba ste/ de'ang don gsum gyi rgyu ji ltar yin zhe na/ yon tan bzhi ldan gyi chos sku dang / de bzhin nyid kyi dri ma sbyong ba dang / mngon du byed pa'i rigs kyis mi sbyong ba dang —/ nus pa 'phel ba'i rgyu yin pas so/ / 9 (gnyis)so sor bshad pa/— gnyis pa la ngo bo dang / rgyu bshad gnyis kyi/ 96

(gcig)ngo bo bshad pa/dang po ni/ don gsum gyi rang mtshan las brtsams nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos sku ni bsam pa'i don 'grub pa sogs mthu dang ldan pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang de bzhin nyid gzhan du mi 'gyur bas nam mkha' dang / rigs ni sems can la snying brtses brlan pa'i ngo bo'i rang bzhin yin pas chu'i yon tan dang chos mthun pa nyid yin la/spyi mtshan las brtsams nas don gsum po 'di thams cad kyang rang bzhin gyis dag pas dpe gsum char dang don mthun te/ rtsa bar spyi dang so so'i chos mthun bstan nas phan tshun kha bskangs bar mngon no—/ /(gnyis)rgyu bshad pa/gnyis pa la gsum ste/ spang bya dang / gnyen po dang / gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu'o/ /〈gcig〉spang bya/dang po ni/ spyir sems can gyi rigs gsum ste/ srid pa 'dod pa dang / srid bral 'dod pa dang / de gnyis ga mi 'dod pa'o/ /97

rten de dag gi rgyud la yod pa'i spang bya la/ theg chen gyi chos la khong khro ba ni srid pa nyid 'dod pa'i 'dod chen po'i sgrib pa dang / chos rnams la bdag tu lta ba ni srid bral 'dod kyang thabs min pa la zhugs pa'i mu stegs byed rnams kyi sgrib pa dang / rang nyid 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs pa dang sems can gyi don la ltos pa med pa ni rim pa ltar srid bral 'dod pa thabs la zhugs pa nyan thos dang rang byung rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi sgrib pa ste rnam pa bzhi'o/ /〈gnyis〉gnyen po/gnyis pa ni/ yon tan bzhi ldan gyi chos sku rnam par dag pa thob pa'i rgyu ni 'khor 'das gnyis ka mi 'dod pa byang sems kyi rgyud kyi theg chen la lhag par mos pa dang / sogs pas bdag med rtogs pa'i sher phyin dang / nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting nge 'dzin dang snying rje chen po bsgom pa'o/ /de la byang sems kyi rgyud la mos pa sogs kyis gang zag bzhi la yod pa dang cha 'dra ba'i rang rgyud kyi sgrib pa bzhi spong ngo / /'dod chen pa sogs bzhi'i rgyud kyi sgrib pa dngos su mi spong yang sgrib pa de bzhi 'dod chen pa sogs la shas che bas de skad bshad pa'o/ /〈gsum〉gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu/98

gsum pa ni/ ji ltar yab rgyal po'i sa bon dang de'i btsun mo dam pa dang de'i mngal gnas ma nyams pa dang skyes nas bskyed bsring ba'i ma ma khyad par can te/ rgyu bzhi las rgyal po'i gdung 'tshob nus pa'i sras 'byung ba ltar theg pa mchog la mos pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa bon dang bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab ni sangs rgyas kyi chos bskyed pa'i ma dang nam mkha' mdzod la sogs pa'i bsam gtan gyi bde ba'i mngal na gnas pa dang / rtogs pa 'phel ba'i rgyu snying rje'i ma ma can gang yin pa de ni thub pa'i rjes su skyes pa'i sras te de'i gdung 'tshob nus par 'gyur ro/ /(gnyis〉'bras bu dang las kyi don/gnyis pa 'bras bu dang las kyi don la gnyis las/(gcig)thun mong du bstan pa/thun mong du bstan pa la 'bras bu ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gtsang ba dang bdag dang bde ba dang rtag pa nyid kyi yon tan bzhitshi pha rol te mthar phyin pa ni chos mos sogs bzhi'i 'bras bu'o/ /'bras bu bzhi po don gsum gyi 'bras bu ji ltar yin zhe na/ sangs 99

rgyas snga ma'i chos sku las chos ston pa dang / de las chos la mos pa dang / de las gtsang ba 'byung bas gtsang ba chos sku'i rgyu 'bras dang /de bzhin nyid kyi yul can shes rab las bdag dam pa 'byung bas de yul de bzhin nyid kyi 'bras bur bzhag pa dang / rigs kyi 'bras bu ting nge 'dzin dang snying rje las bde ba dam pa dang rtag pa dam pa'i pha rol tu son pa gnyis 'byung bas rigs kyi 'bras bu'o/ /las ni 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la yid 'byung ba dang / sdug bsngal zhi ba myang 'das thob par mngon par 'dod pa'i 'dun pa dang smon pa'i las can te/ dngos su rigs sad pa'i las yin zhing rigs sad pa'ang chos sku'i bdag rkyen dang rang bzhin rnam dag gi khams yod pa'i stobs kyis yin pas de dag gi'ang las su bzhag go/ /(gnyis)so sor bshad pa/so sor bshad pa la gnyis te/ 'bras bu bshad pa dang / las bshad pa'o/ /(gcilnga'abras bu bshad pa/dang po la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa'o—/ / 100

〈gcig〉mdor bstan pa/dang po ni/ phyin ci log bzhi dang de las bzlog pa phyin ci ma log pa bzhi ni nyan rang gis phung po mi gtsang ba sogs bzhir mthong ba dang —/ de'i gnyen po chos sku gtsang ba sogs bzhi ldan no/ /gtsang ba sogs yon tan bzhi ni sangs rgyas nyid la mnga' yi gzhan la med de/'di ltar dgra bcom pa dang rang sangs rgyas dang dbang thob pa'i byang sems la'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos sku yon tan bzhi ldan thob pa'i gegs su gyur pa rkyen dang rgyu dang 'byung ba dang 'jig pa'i mtshan nyid bzhi'o/ /de la rkyen ni ma rig bag chags kyis te ma rig pa bzhin no—/ /rgyu ni rkyen des bslangs pa'i bag med kyi las te 'du byed bzhin nospyo/ /'byung ba ni de gnyis kyi rkyen dang rgyu can gyi yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus gsum grub pa ste len pa'i rkyen gyis srid pa gsum grub pa bzhin no/ /'jig pa ni lus de'i rkyen can bsam gyis mi khyab par yongs su bsgyur ba'i 'chi 'pho ste skye ba'i rkyen can rga shi bzhin no/ /dgra bcom sogs gsum gyis ma rig pa'i bag chags kyis ma spangayo pas gtsang ba mi thob bo/ /sa de'i rkyen can mtshan ma'i spros pa kun tu spyod pa phra mo dang ldan pas bdag dam pa dang / mtshan ma phra mo des bslangs pa'i zag mad kyi las la brten nas yid kyi rang bzhin gyi phung 101

po 'byung bas de 'gags pa'i bde ba dang ci/ —de ma 'gag pa'i bar du bsam gyis mi khyab par bsgyur ba'i 'chi 'pho rdeng mi 'bral bas rtag pa mi thob pas so/ /dpal phreng du bcom ldan 'das dper na len pa'i rkyen gyis zag pa dang bcas pa'i las kyi rgyu las byung ba srid pa gsum 'byung ba de bzhin du/ bcom ldan 'das ma rig pa'i bag chags kyi sa'i rkyen gyis zag pa med pa'i las kyi rgyu las byung ba dgra bcom pa dang rang sangs rgyas dang dbang thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus gsum 'byung ste zhes sogs rgyas par 'byung ngo / /del ma rig pa bag chags kyi sa ni 'jug pa'i rang 'grel dang / snying po mchog la sogs par shes bya yongs su gcod pa 'i gegs su bshad do/ /ngo bo ni nyon mongs pa'i bag chags te sgrib pa'i rten byed pas sa zhes bshad do/ /mtshan ma'i spros pa ni zag med kyi las kun nas slong byed kyi zhen pa phra mo ste/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdor—/ thabs la mkhas pa'i dge rtsa la nyon mongs su btags pa rnamasasal chos su zhen pa phra mo yod par bshad pa dang don gcig go /'a bum ṭīg tu zag med kyi las kyi lhan cig byed rkyen du lkebashad pa yang ma rig bag chags kyi sa de nyid do༈ tsho /byang sems 'phags pā'i zag med kyi sems pā'i las ma rig bag chags kyi rkyen can ni zag med kyi lasta so/ /yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus ni jici skad bstan pa'i rgyu rkyen de 102

dag gis bskyed pa'i 'bras bu yid ltar thogs pa med pa'i lus su snang ba'o—/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho ni bsams bzhin du yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus 'dor len byed pa'o/ /〈gnyis〉rgyas par bshad pa/gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku de ni spyi'i mtshan nyid rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i phyir dang / khyad par gyi— mtshan nyid glo bur gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pa'i phyir gtsang ba dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /spyi'i mtshan nyid ni dri ma'i ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa dri mas ma dag pa'i sems thams cad kyi thun mong ba yin la/khyad par gyi mtshan nyid ni glo bur gyi dri ma spangs pa ste/ zag pa med pa'i sems kho na'i khyad par gyi chos so/ /mu stegs pas btags pa'i gang zag gi bdag dang / nyan thos pas btags pa'i chos kyi bdag gnyis kyi spros pa mtha' dag nye bar zhi ba'i phyir/ bdag dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /'di ni bdag med la bdag tu byas pa ste/ mi gnas pa'i tshul gyis gnas zhes pa ltar ro/ /yid kyi rang bzhin gyi phung po dang de'i rgyu ma rig bag chags kyi sa dang zag med kyi las log pa ste spangs pa'i phyir/ bde ba dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa blang dor tha dad du mi rtog par 103

mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i phyir/ rtag pa dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o—/ /'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i rgyu ni thabs dang shes rab gnyis po ste/ 'di gnyis bla na med pa'i byang chugakyi rtsa ba'o / /ji ltar rtsa ba yin zhe na/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis bdag la sred pa ma lus pa bcad pa'i phyir/ de ltar blo'am shes rab bla med byang chub kyi thabs su gyur pa yin no/ /byang sems 'phags pa chos can/ 'khor ba la gnas par mi 'gyur te/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab de rgyud la bsten par byas pas so/ /brtse ldan byang sems de chos can/ gzhan don rgyun chad pa'i zhi ba myang 'das thob par byed pa ma yin te/ sred pa ste snying rjes sems can mi gtong ba'i phyir / de ltar brtse ba bla med byang chub kyi thabs su gyur pa yin no/ /byang sems 'phags pa de chos can/ mya ngan las 'das pa la gnas par mi bya ste/ brtse ba snying rje chen po rgyud la bsten par byas pas so/ /(gnyis)las kyi don bshad pa/gnyis pa las kyi don la gnyis te/ rigs kyi las yod pa ldog pa'i sgo nas bsgrub pa dang / rjes su 'gro ldog gnyis ka'i sgo nas bsgrub pa'o/ / 104

〈gcig〉rigs kyi las yod pa ljog pa'i sgo nas bsgrub pa/dang po ni/ gal te rtag mtha' bzung ste sems can la sangs rgyas kyi khams med na de sad pa mi srid pas su yang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la skyo bar mi 'gyur zhing / mya ngan las 'das pa la thob pa'i blos phyogs pa'i 'dod pa dang / thob pa'i thabs tshol ba'i don gnyer dang glu/ thob par gyur cig snyam pa'i smon pa med par 'gyur ro/ /'di 'bras bu'i cha 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la skyo ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa la 'dod pa ste/ phyi ma ni skyo ba'i rgyu 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi skyon mthong ba dang / 'dod pa'i rgyu mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba'i phan yon mthong ba ni sh+lau ka snga phyi'i las kyi khyad par ro/ /'di dag kyang dngos su na bsgrubs pa'i rigs kyi las te/ de yang rang bzhin gyis gnas pa'i rigs rkyen gyis gsos pa las byung ba la'ang mi 'khrul lo—/ /des na 'grel par sangs rgyas kyi khams rnam par dag pa'i rigs ni log pa nyid du nges pa'i sems can rnams la yang las rnam pa gnyis te nye bar gnas par byed ces so/ /rang bzhin gnas rigs 'dus ma byas chos nyid 'ba' zhig tu 'dod pa la ni rkyen gyis sad pa'i don med pas rig pa'i cha'ang 'dod dgos so/ /des na rig pas ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi nyer len gyi rgyu byed la/ de yang 105

rang bzhin gyis mi stong na mi 'gyur bas rkyen gyis gsos btab par mi rung ngo / /des na rang bzhin gyis stong pas khyad par du byas pa'i sems las 'bras bu 'byung ba'i phyir/ dbyings rig dbyer med la 'dod dgos so/ /〈gnyis〉rjes su 'gro ldog gnyis ka'i sgo nas bsgrub pa/gnyis pa ni/ skyes bu dam pa la bsten pa dang / mthun pa'i yul na gnas pa dang / sngon dge ba byas pa dang / yang dag pa'i smon lam btab pa ste/ 'khor lo bzhi dang ldan pa'i gang zag srid pa de'i sdug bsngal gyi skyon dang / mya ngan las 'das pa la de'i bde ba'i phan yon mthong ba 'di ni rigs yod pa sad par gyur pa las yin gyi rigs sad pa'i rgyu dang rkyen med par min te/ gang gi phyir na khyod rigs sad pa'i rgyu rkyen med par yang yod na/ log sred can mya ngan las mi 'da' ba'i rigs can la'ang rigs ma sad pa'i gong du yod par 'gyur ba las med pa'i phyir ro/ /log sred can yang 'khor lo bzhi 'byor ba'i tshul gyis theg pa gsum gang rung gi sa la mos pa bskyed nas rigs sad pa'i tshe las de dag 'byung ste/ ye shes snang ba rgyan gyi mdor—/ de'i 'og tu ni tha na log pa nyid du nges pa'i rgyud du gyur pa'i sems can rnams kyi lus la yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 106

'khor gyi ye shes kyi 'od phog pas de dag la phan thogs par 'gyur zhing ma 'ongs pa'i rgyu yang dag par skyes pa na dge ba'i chos rnams kyis rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de'i 'og tu zhes smos pa ni/ dper na nyi mas dang por ri mtho ba sogs nas rim gyis snang bar byas nas/ de'i 'og tu 'dzam bu'i gling 'di'i sa phyogs dma' ba dag kyang snang bar byed pa ltar/ dang po gnas skabs theg pa gsum du nges pa'i rigs can dang ma nges pa'i rigs can gyi don byas nas/ de'i 'og tu log sred can gyi sems can gyi yang don byed do—/ /'o na myang 'das chen po nas log sred can gtan yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' ba'i chos can zhes gsungs pa ci yin zhe na/ de ni drang don dgongs pa can te/ dgos pa theg chen la sdang ba gtan mi thar zhes pas shin tu skrag nas/ de bzlog pa'i don du dgongs gzhi dus ring du mi thar bas dus gzhan la dgongs nas gsungs pa ste/dngos la gnod byed ni rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i rigs yod pa'i phyir/ log sred can sogs 'ga' yang gtan rnam par dag par mi 'gyur bar ni 'os pa min te/ gang gi phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis khyad par med par sems can thams cad la rnam par dag par rung ba nyid yod pa la dgongs nas/ thog med gyur kyang tha ma dang ldan pa/ /rang bzhin gyis dag rtag pa'i chos can ni/ /thog med spubs kyis phyi 107

bsgribs mi mthong ste/ /ji ltar gser gyi gzugs ni bsgribs pa bzhin—/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar lung dang rigs pas rigs chad kyi sems can bkag go/ /theg pa chen po'i rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs ni dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems kyi chos dbyings su gsungs te/mngon rtogs rgyan du/ sgrub pa yin rten gyur pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dang / /zhes gsungs pas rigs chad kyi sems can mi srid do—/ /mdo sde rgyan las ni/ bde gshegs snying po dang rigs tha dad du gsungs te/ bde gshegs snying po sems can thams cad la yod par bshad cing / rigs chad kyi sems can yod par bstan pas/ bde gshegs snying po dang rigs mi gcig par 'dod pa sems tsam pa'i lugs so/ / 〈gsum〉 ldan pa'i don/ gsum pa ldan pa'i don la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / (gcig)mdor bstan pa/dang po la rgyu'i ldan pa ni/ rgya mtsho chen po'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar rin po che dang chu dpag tu med pa 'du ba bzhin du de bzhin 108

gshegs pa'i khams kyang mos pa'i snod du shes rab dang ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan rin po che dpag tu med pa dang snying rje'i chu mi zad pa'i gnas so/ /'bras bu'i ldan pa ni mngon shes dang po lnga dang zag med kyi ye shes dang / spangs pa rnams dbyer med pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i phyir/ mar me la chos gsum dbyer med pa bzhin no/ /de la rgyu rigs kyi ldan pa dang / 'bras bu chos sku'i ldan pa dang / de bzhin nyid kyi ldan pa gnyis ka'o/ /(gnyis)rgyas par bshad pa/bshad pa la rgyu'i ldan pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos sku thob pa'i rgyu theg chen gyi chos la mos pa bsgom pa ni snod dang chos mthun te/shes rab dang ting nge 'dzin gyi rin po che dang snying rje'i chu rnams der 'du bas so/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes kyi rgyu shes rab dang ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa ni rin po che dang chos mthun te/ rin po che rtog pa med cing mthu mang ba ltar/ shes rab kyis bdag gnyis su rtog pa med cing ting nge 'dzin dang mngon shes sogs kyi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pas so—/ /thugs rje chen po'i khams te rgyu snying rje chen po bsgom pa ni chu dang chos mthun te/ 'gro ba thams cad la mchog tu brlan pa'i rang bzhin du ro gcig pas so/ /de ltar gnas gsum po 'di rgya mtsho chen 109
